ActionContribution.description: Changes the list of actions the player is offered here: union adds actions, override adds or replaces them, replace offers exactly these, subtract removes them, intersect keeps only these. Each key names a built-in verb or one of the game's actions.

op.description: How the actions apply to the set so far: union, override, replace, subtract or intersect.

ActionCost.description: What the action costs the player each time, failure included: an amount of one pool, such as 5 mv. Without enough, the action is refused and nothing happens.

amount.description: How much it pays on every admitted perform.

resource.description: The resource the body pays.

ActionCraft.description: What a crafting action uses up and makes. consume: the items taken from the player's hands into a holder on every try; yield: an item moved from a holder to the player unless the action fails.

consume.description: What the actor gives up on every accepted perform, failure included.

items.description: The items that can be consumed.

quantity.description: How many of them are consumed.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the actor holds too few.

to.description: Where the consumed items go: the holder they are moved to.

yield.description: What the actor receives unless the outcome is failure.

from.description: The holder the yielded item is taken from.

items.description: The items that can be yielded; one of them, directly in the holder, moves to the actor's body.

ActionInputParameter.description: An input parameter an action requires (06 §20), one of the ActionInput fields.

ActionNarration.description: A scripted action outcome's narration: the actor's line, the observers' line, and the entities the actor's line names, each resolved and pinned when the outcome commits.

actor.description: Text key of the actor's line.

observers.description: Text key of the observers' line.

participants.description: The entities the actor's line names.

Alias.description: A word the player types to name something or start an action: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by _ (the player types mooring post, you write mooring_post). At most 64 characters.

AmbientSet.description: Lines told now and then: each time the clock passes a multiple of every and the chance passes, one of the lines is shown. A room, item or NPC shows at most one ambient line each time the clock moves on.

chance.description: Percent chance it fires when due, 1 to 100; 100 when absent.

every.description: Logical seconds between chances; a set is due when the clock crosses a multiple of it.

when.description: A condition read with the entity as target (a room has none); the first set whose when holds is the active one.

AmbientSets.description: The ambient lines of a room or item, in order.

AncestrySpec.description: One authored character choice and its bounded initial effects.

attribute.description: The attribute this choice raises at birth, by modifier.

dark_sight.description: When true, the character sees in the dark.

description.description: Text key of the choice's description.

faction.description: A fact set when the choice is made.

fact.description: The fact; it must be player-scoped.

value.description: The value the fact is set to.

modifier.description: Added to the attribute's starting value; at least 1.

name.description: Text key of the choice's label.

skill.description: A skill granted at birth, without learning; it may not have a prerequisite.

ApiVersion.description: Which version of the game file format this file is written for.

anyOf.description: A status this food or drink puts on the player, with an optional duration in game time units that replaces the status's own. Eating again while it lasts keeps whichever end is later.

duration.description: How long it lasts, in game time units; replaces the status's own length.

status.description: The status it applies, such as poisoned.

AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

attacks.description: Swings: how many swings one opportunity makes, each rolled on its own, their damage summed (1 to 10; default 1).

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

crit.description: A hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent of all attacks, sharing the accuracy draw: a hit whose draw is below this is critical, so a chance above the accuracy makes every hit critical.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

BandTable.description: How a pool's level is described, highest first: each row names a band and the level it starts at, and the last row starts at 0.

BandTone.description: A condition band's tone: how serious the band is; each presenter maps it to its own colour.

BarrierState.description: A door's state: open, closed or locked. A locked door is always closed.

Calendar.description: The game's clock: how many time units make an hour, hours in a day, the parts of the day shown to the player, and optional sun and moon phases. Seasons, tides and a weather table can be added.

lunar.description: The moon's phases: a repeating cycle with a length and named phases.

season.description: The seasons: a repeating cycle with a length and named phases.

solar.description: The parts of the day, such as dawn, day, dusk and night, each starting at a time into the day.

start.description: The logical time a new world begins at.

subdivisions_per_hour.description: Parts the status line splits an hour into; must divide units_per_hour.

tide.description: The tides: a repeating cycle with a length and named phases.

units_per_hour.description: Logical time units in one hour; the three unit fields are given together.

weather.description: The possible weathers. Each day gets one, weighted by each entry's weight; the same world and day always get the same weather.

CalendarCut.description: An inclusive phase start within one authored solar day or lunar period.

at.description: Logical units into the solar day (or the cycle) at which this phase starts; the first cut of a cycle is 0.

phase.description: The phase's name, lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

CalendarCycle.description: A repeating cycle, such as the moon, seasons or tides: a period and the phases it passes through, each starting at a point in the cycle (the first at 0).

origin.description: The time at which the cycle is at its start (position 0).

period.description: Length of the cycle in logical units.

phases.description: The named phases in order, each with the time it starts; the first starts at 0.

CapabilityVersion.description: A capability contract version: a positive integer. key@version is immutable in meaning once published; a breaking change takes a new version.

CapabilityVersions.description: Exact capability pins, capability key to version. A map, so one version per key: the canonical decoder rejects a repeated key, and canonical encoding sorts keys.

CartridgeId.description: A cartridge identity, lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

Chapter.description: An ordered chapter marker: name is a catalog key; only chapter 0 lacks a story_point, and it has no outcome. Later chapters name a story point and optionally one of its outcome keys (checked at the reference stage).

name.description: Text key of its name.

outcome.description: One outcome key of that story point.

story_point.description: The story point that opens it; only chapter 0 lacks one.

anyOf.description: A roll of chance: passes when a random number from 0 to 99 is below chance. Example: chance 50 passes half the time.

chance.description: Passes when a draw from 0 to 99 is below this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A fixed test: passes when the player's resource, such as stamina, is at least difficulty. No dice.

difficulty.description: Passes when the resource is at least this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

resource.description: The body's resource, read at admission before costs.

anyOf.description: Passes when the actor's value of the attribute is at least difficulty; draws no random number.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A test of the player's skill or attribute against a number (rating) or against an NPC's attribute. It never rolls dice: it passes when the player's value is at least the other.

attribute.description: The attribute compared; give this or skill, not both.

failure.description: The failure branch; a dialogue choice needs it, a scripted action refuses it.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

npc.description: With attribute, compares against this NPC's value of the attribute instead of a rating.

rating.description: The target detail's rating; a scripted action refuses it.

skill.description: The skill whose level is compared; give this or attribute, not both.

anyOf.description: Passes while the named population has left a fresh trail in the player's room. It never rolls dice. On success, the outcome's lines are followed by a line pointing the way the trail leads.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

plan.description: Key of the population plan whose trail is looked for; passes when that trail is fresh in the actor's room.

Check.description: A test the action makes before it succeeds; kind says which sort of test.

ClientFeature.description: A presentation/input capability of the installed Loka app, lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

CombatSettings.description: Cartridge-owned attack profile, round interval, position multipliers and combat narration keys. Compiler and loader enforce its executable capability and death-setting dependencies.

allies.description: Authored NPCs that fight beside the player: the first listed one living in the encounter room strikes the player's target each round, is never an attack target, and its kill credits the player.

conditions.description: Condition lines, highest at_percent first: after each round, the first row the player's living foe's hp reaches is told, binding {target}.

at_percent.description: The percent of the foe's hp range it must reach.

dodge.description: Percent chance to dodge an enemy attack that would otherwise hit; absent means no dodge.

skill.description: The skill that must be usable for a dodge.

flee_multiplier.description: Multiplies the move cost of a body that is engaged.

initiative.description: Opts into Diku rounds: each round draws initiative for which side strikes first, Attack resolves round 1 at once, and the combat narration binds {attacker} and {target}.

narration.description: Text keys told in combat rounds.

ally_hit.description: Told when an ally's strike hits.

ally_miss.description: Told when an ally's strike misses.

ally_volley.description: Swings: the summary line before an ally's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and some but not all hit, and more than one; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

ally_volley_all.description: Swings: the summary line before an ally's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and every one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

ally_volley_one.description: Swings: the summary line before an ally's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and exactly one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

npc_died.description: Told when an NPC falls in a combat round.

npc_hit.description: Told when an NPC's attack hits the player.

npc_miss.description: Told when an NPC's attack misses the player.

npc_volley.description: Swings: the summary line before an NPC's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and some but not all hit, and more than one; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

npc_volley_all.description: Swings: the summary line before an NPC's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and every one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

npc_volley_one.description: Swings: the summary line before an NPC's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and exactly one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

player_died.description: Told when the player falls in a combat round; also the default fall line for tick deaths.

player_hit.description: Told when the player's attack hits.

player_miss.description: Told when the player's attack misses.

player_volley.description: Swings: the summary line before the player's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and some but not all hit, and more than one; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

player_volley_all.description: Swings: the summary line before the player's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and every one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

player_volley_one.description: Swings: the summary line before the player's strike line when its profile makes more than one swing and exactly one hit; binds count and hits. No key, no line.

shot_hit.description: Told when a ranged first strike hits. Required when any item declares weapon.ranged.

shot_miss.description: Told when a ranged first strike misses. Required when any item declares weapon.ranged.

player_attack.description: The player's unarmed attack: chance to hit and damage range.

sleep_multiplier.description: Multiplies an NPC's damage against a sleeping player.

target_choice.description: Opts into target choice: during a roster encounter the player's attack on another present active member makes it the primary the player strikes.

tiers.description: Damage tiers, highest at_percent first: a hit whose hp loss reaches at_percent of the target's hp maximum is told with the first such tier's key for that perspective instead of the plain hit key.

ally_hit.description: Told for the ally's hit at this tier.

at_percent.description: The percent of the target's hp maximum a hit's loss must reach.

npc_hit.description: Told for the foe's hit at this tier.

player_hit.description: Told for the player's hit at this tier.

shot_hit.description: Told for a ranged first strike's hit at this tier.

CompatibilityRequirements.description: Which engine versions and features this game needs to run. Published games pin each version exactly.

capabilities.description: Each capability the cartridge uses, with its version; using a feature whose capability is not listed is refused.

client_features.description: Features the app must offer; the cartridge is refused where one is missing.

content_schema.description: Content schema version; must equal the one the engine supports (currently 1).

kernel_api.description: The range of engine versions this cartridge works with.

rule_ir.description: Rule format version; must equal the one the engine supports (currently 1).

ConditionBand.description: One row of a condition band table: the band key holds when p, the percentage of the pool's range from its minimum, reaches at_percent (in integers: 100 x (current - minimum) >= at_percent x (maximum - minimum)). key is a content Key whose text is band.<key> in the catalog when the cartridge authors it; tone is how serious it is.

at_percent.description: The percentage of the pool's range at which it holds.

key.description: The band key; its text is band.<key> when authored.

Connection.description: An exit to another room of this game. Add a door with barrier; the room on the other side needs the matching exit back with the same door.

barrier.description: The barrier the exit passes through.

climb.description: This exit is a climb: a player holding the named item climbs safely; without it they fall, still arrive, and lose some health (never below 1).

damage.description: HP a fall costs; a fall never takes HP below 1.

item.description: The item a mover must hold to climb rather than fall.

corpse_ingress.description: Close this directed exit while the named global fact has the specified value, except for the living owner of a nonempty player corpse in its destination. The exception is rechecked at movement admission.

equals.description: The value at which the exit is closed.

fact.description: The global fact that closes the exit.

hidden_until.description: This exit is hidden from the player until the named fact has the given value.

equals.description: The value that reveals the exit; of the fact's type.

fact.description: A fact of this cartridge, normally a player bool; the exit stays hidden until it has the value.

knock.description: The face's answer to a knock.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to go through this exit; otherwise the move is refused.

traverse.description: A condition the player must meet to go through this exit.

to.description: The room this exit leads to.

Cue.description: Something a listener hears, smells or feels from its source. sense: sound, smell or heat; text: the line, in that sense's words; range: how many rooms away it carries through exits, 0 (same room only) to 2; when: an optional condition on the listener. The room, detail, item, NPC, lit light, status or action outcome that declares it is its source.

range.description: Rooms it carries through exits, 0 to 2.

when.description: A condition read for the listener.

Cues.description: A source's sense cues, in authored order.

DamageKind.description: A damage kind: a closed engine vocabulary shared by attack profiles and NPC resistances. A row that needs a new kind adds it here; a kind never shares a name with a Tag.

DeathCredit.description: Finite authored death credit linking one local attackable NPC, its authored room and a player Boolean fact with false default. Compiler and loader enforce references and unique NPC/fact ownership.

fact.description: The player Boolean fact with false default.

npc.description: The attackable NPC.

DeathSettings.description: What happens at death: the corpse made for the player and for NPCs, the room the player wakes in, and how their pools are restored.

narration.description: A player's death lines outside a combat round. player_died: the fall line a bleed or status tick death tells after its tick line (default world.combat.narration.player_died; a drowning tells world.water.drowned instead). woke: told once after every player death, combat included, after the penalty line.

player_died.description: The fall line a bleed or status tick death tells after its tick line.

woke.description: Told once after every player death, after the penalty line.

npc_corpse.description: Corpse template for an NPC, unless its population names its own.

npc_corpse_decay.description: Logical units from an NPC's death until its corpse decays: direct items spill to the room, the corpse leaves play. Omitted: never.

penalty.description: What dying costs the player. experience: a percent of experience lost, but never below the start of the current level (needs levelling in the world settings). items: corpse (the default) moves what the player held into the corpse; kept leaves it with the player.

experience.description: Experience lost on death; needs world.levelling.

narration.description: Told once when experience is lost.

percent.description: The body loses floor(experience * percent / 100), never below its current level's threshold.

items.description: What happens to what the body held: corpse (the default) moves it into the corpse; kept leaves it on the body.

player_corpse_decay.description: Logical units from a player's death until the corpse decays, as npc_corpse_decay.

restore.description: The values the dead body's pools are set to.

hp.description: HP after death; capped at the body's HP maximum.

mv.description: Movement after death; capped at the body's movement maximum.

revival.description: What the player sees between dying and waking: lines shown in order, for its seconds.

shrine.description: The room a dead player's body returns to.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

DerivedStat.description: One stat's bonus from attributes: for each term, the attribute's value minus pivot, times per_point; the sum is divided by divisor (default 1) and rounded down.

divisor.description: The sum of the terms is divided by this, rounded down; default 1.

terms.description: The attributes that make up the bonus; each adds per_point times (the attribute's value minus pivot).

per_point.description: Bonus added per point of the attribute above pivot (below it, taken away).

pivot.description: The attribute value at which this term adds nothing.

DescriptionVariant.description: Prose selected by a condition: description replaces the base description key when the condition holds for the actor over committed state. A room's or detail's variants are tried in list order and the first whose condition holds is shown; when none holds, the base description is. Variants are derived, never a mutated description. Owned by description_variant (a cartridge with one requires it); its condition's ops by their owners.

description.description: Text key shown when it holds.

DialogueChoice.description: One option the player can pick in a conversation: its button text, the line it tells, and what it does (steps, a quest to accept, an item to hand over). It can also have a condition that hides it, a check with what opens next on success (then) or failure (then_failed), or then: end to close the conversation.

accept.description: A quest of this cartridge the choice activates.

asked.description: The Book dims this choice once taken; it stays usable. Lowered to the fact <dialogue>_<choice>_asked, a step that sets it and asked_when.

availability.description: Time limits on offering the choice.

from.description: First logical time the choice is offered.

through.description: Last logical time the choice is offered, inclusive.

check.description: An opposed check made when chosen.

escort.description: Starts, rejoins or completes an escort: npc names the NPC who follows the player. start and rejoin keep the conversation going; complete finishes the dialogue's quest.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

hand_over.description: The item role the actor gives to an npc role.

lesson_payment.description: An amount of a resource the actor pays for a lesson.

amount.description: How much.

resource.description: The resource paid.

narration.description: Text key of what the actor reads on choosing.

narration_variants.description: Other lines read on choosing, each used while its condition holds.

once.description: This choice goes away once taken: lowered to the fact <dialogue>_<choice>_done, a step that sets it and a policy that needs it unset.

order.description: Where this choice is listed, lowest first; choices without one come after, and ties are sorted by key.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

payment.description: An amount of a resource paid to the actor by an NPC role.

amount.description: How much.

resource.description: The resource paid.

policy.description: When this option is shown: a condition the player must meet, checked with the speaker.

receive.description: The bound NPC-held item transferred to the actor.

sitting.description: Once taken, this choice is hidden until the conversation is next opened. Only on a plain answer in a dialogue that reopens.

steps.description: What happens when the player picks this option, in order.

story_point.description: <story point>/<outcome>: the outcome this choice reaches; one per outcome.

then.description: The conversation to go to next, or end to finish talking.

then_failed.description: The conversation to go to next when this option's check fails.

anyOf.description: An NPC of this cartridge takes this role.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

anyOf.description: An item of this cartridge takes this role.

DialogueRole.description: Who plays this role in the conversation: an NPC or item of this game.

EscortStatus.description: The bounded escort lifecycle: following moves with the actor, separated waits for explicit rejoin, completed never follows again.

ExecutionProfile.description: A hosting profile a cartridge supports or a deployment uses: the canonical execution-profile vocabulary.

anyOf.description: True or false.
One of a list of words; the starting value must be one of them.

default.description: Value before any assignment; one of values.

values.description: The keys the fact may hold.

anyOf.description: A whole number, optionally between a lowest and a highest value (both allowed); the starting value must be within them.

FactType.description: What kind of value the fact holds and where it starts: true or false (bool), one of a list of words (enum), or a whole number with optional bounds (int).

FactValue.description: A fact's value: a word, a whole number, or true or false, matching the fact's type.

anyOf.description: A lightable item that burns fuel while lit, and is refilled from a supply item.

capacity.description: The most fuel the source holds, in its unit.

cues.description: Cues active only while this source is lit.

doused.description: Text key of the line told when it is put out.

ignited.description: Text key of the line told when it is lit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

rate.description: Fuel burned per logical time unit while lit; at least 1. It goes out when the fuel runs out.

refueled.description: Text key of the line told when it is refilled.

supply.description: The supply item that refuels it; the supply's unit must match.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; the supply must use the same one.

anyOf.description: An item that holds fuel for refilling sources; it is emptied by what it gives.

capacity.description: The most fuel the supply holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; a source takes only a supply with the same one.

FuelSpec.description: Immutable authored source or supply metadata; sources bind one compatible supply and their narration keys.

InspectableDetail.description: Something in a room the player can look at, such as a well or a painting: the words that name it (the first is its own name and must not start with a, an, the or at), its description, and other descriptions picked by condition.

aliases.description: The words a player names it by; the first also names an ambiguous lookup.

bed.description: Makes the detail a bed: resting here is offered when the entitlement fact reads true.

entitlement.description: The fact that must read true for the actor before resting here is offered.

title.description: Text key of the title of the bed's page.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this detail: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

harvest.description: Makes the detail a place to gather items from.

careful.description: A slower way to gather: several items at once, for a skilled actor.

action.description: The harvest action offered for it; must be a harvest action that takes a method.

count.description: Items gathered at once; 2 to 64, and at most the distinct items listed.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after a careful harvest.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable for the careful way.

items.description: The item definitions that can be gathered; each harvest takes the ones lying in the room.

label.description: Text key of the harvest action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after an ordinary harvest (one item).

title.description: Text key of the title of the harvest page.

tool.description: Harvest needs a held item whose definition declares tag.

tag.description: The tag a held item must carry for the harvest to be allowed.

liquid_source.description: The liquid a held vessel can be filled with at this detail.

notice_board.description: Makes the detail a board that lists other readable details of the room.

notices.description: The notices on the board, in order: 1 to 64, all different.

detail.description: A readable detail in the same room.

title.description: The notice's title on the board.

self_luminous.description: Must be true: the detail gives light, so it is seen in a dark room.

title.description: Text key of the title of the detail's page.

rating.description: The value an opposed scripted action check against this detail must reach.

readable.description: Text the player can read here, and the label of the read action; both are text keys.

title.description: Text key of the title of the readable's page; without it the label is shown.
The title shown on this detail's page in the Book (a text key). Without it the page uses a general title.

transport.description: Makes the detail a stop on a transport route.

route.description: The transport route this stop belongs to.

title.description: Text key of the title of the stop's page.

ItemAffect.description: Adds an amount to an attribute while the item is worn or the status lasts, such as strength +1. Use a negative amount to lower it.

ItemBandage.description: A directly held item opted into exact bleed treatment.

action.description: Must be bandage: the key of the action that applies it.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when the bandage is applied.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable to bandage.

ItemEdible.description: Held-food metadata; a complete original item grants its effect (capped recovery, cures, applies) when Consume commits.

amount.description: Positive integer; the canonical numeric profile supplies the safe-integer upper limit.

applies.description: Statuses Consume applies to the eater's body after the recovery and any cures, through the shared status apply (status_applied on a first application, immune holds, a refresh is silent); none may modify an hp-maximum attribute.

cures.description: Statuses this food ends when eaten; the player may eat it while one is active even when full.

label.description: Text key of the eat action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when it is eaten.

resource.description: The pool eating restores (for example mv); with amount, or neither.

anyOf.description: Starts lying in a room.
Starts carried by an NPC.

npc.description: The NPC carrying it.

anyOf.description: Starts inside another item of this cartridge.
Starts nowhere: it is a copy source only, and exists in play only once another rule makes a copy.

ItemLocation.description: Where the item is when the game starts: in a room, held by an NPC, or inside another item.

ItemReadable.description: One explicit held-item Read, with optional declared Boolean topic grant.

label.description: Text key of the read action's button.

text.description: Text key of what the player reads.

topic.description: A topic the reader learns on reading.

KernelApiRange.description: The kernel_api compatibility range a cartridge declares: at_least inclusive, below exclusive, so '>=1.3 <2.0' is at_least 1.3, below 2.0.

at_least.description: Lowest kernel API version accepted, inclusive.

below.description: First kernel API version refused: the range stops just under it.

KernelApiVersion.description: A kernel_api version, MAJOR.MINOR without leading zeros.

Key.description: A name the game uses inside: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, at most 64 characters, such as north or old_well.

KnockResponse.description: A local barrier face’s authored answer when the named NPC is in the destination room, and its no-answer text.

npc.description: The NPC listened for.

room.description: The room it must be in.

unanswered.description: Text key of the no-answer line.

LiquidRow.description: Exact vessel contents: null iff zero, positive declared kind bounded by immutable capacity.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

kind.description: The declared liquid; null iff quantity is zero.

ReleaseVersion.description: A release version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata, at most 64 characters.

metal.description: Percent resistance to attacks from a weapon with the material tag `metal`. Negative is a weakness.

credit.description: The true-or-false fact that records the first rest.

entitlement.description: The true-or-false fact that paying for the bed sets.

Revival.description: What the player sees between dying and waking: lines shown in order, over a number of real seconds. It changes nothing in the game.

anyOf.description: The action acts on one detail of a room, offered only while the actor is in that room.

numerator.description: Multiplies the buy price; see denominator.

skill.description: The discount applies while the actor has this skill usable. Give this or friendly.

resource.description: The conserved resource prices are paid in.

sold.description: Text key of the sale narration.

items.description: The interchangeable items sold as one offer; the first is the offer's item.

Some tags do something: a room tagged air, chasm or water admits only a body with a status that allows it, and the world's terrain settings can make moving into a road or marsh room cost more or less.

anyOf.description: The action takes no target.
One entity from the listed scopes.

scopes.description: Where the target is looked for: self, inventory, room_contents, room_occupants or inspectable_details.

TargetSpec.description: The candidate scopes an action's target is resolved from (21 §7): the scopes the R6P proof resolves to an EntityId. Inspectable details use target-only EntityIds and the inspectable_details scope. equipped, connections, party and privileged global scope are added with their first use, with a target identity for non-entity targets (21 §6). Accepted kinds and capabilities are added with the capability registry.

TextCatalog.description: The cartridge's default-locale strings (05 §18: stable string ids, inline defaults extracted into a catalog): each TextKey to its display text, 1 to 4,096 characters. One locale only; per-locale catalogs, plural rules and binding placeholders join later under a new cartridge format tag. Every text key a room, detail, variant, item, NPC (short, room_line, description) or action (label, accessibility) uses has an entry; a string marks its tappable words inline as touch links (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q3): the words in square brackets, which link the thing whose text it is, optionally followed at once by a target key in parentheses, which links that detail of the room or item or NPC of the cartridge instead (DiagnosticCode UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE, TOUCH_LINK_MISSING), so each locale marks its own words; a host showing plain text shows the words without the brackets and target; the compiler reports a missing one as UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE.

TextKey.description: Words shown to the player: write them inline as {"prose": "..."}, or give the key of a text in the text catalog, such as room.well.name (lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores).

TextVariants.description: Other versions of this text, each used while its condition holds; the first that matches wins, else the base text shows.

rate.description: Logical seconds that pass per real second; at least 1.

recap_after_minutes.description: Opt-in: an elapsed settlement spanning at least this many real minutes opens the next Book page with one away recap block; the away cap bounds the threshold, so a capped absence can reach it. At most one week (10080).

liquid.description: A liquid the tool vessel holds some of.

tag.description: A tag the tool item definition declares.

VesselSpec.description: Opted finite vessel shell with authored positive capacity and initial contents.

WaterSettings.description: Exact paired surface/bottom routes, usable skill, entry load/cost, absolute submersion duration and authored warning/death copy; real_elapsed content only.

drowned.description: Text key of the line told when the character drowns.

duration.description: Logical time units a character can stay under before drowning; at least 1.

entry_cost.description: Movement points paid to go under.

maximum_grams.description: The heaviest load, in grams, a character can carry and still go under.

surface.description: The room above the water, where the route is entered.

skill.description: The skill the character must have usable to go under.

warning.description: Text key of the warning shown before going under.

ammo.description: The resource pool one unit of which each shot spends.

skill.description: The required skill.

phase.description: The weather's name, lowercase letters, digits and underscores; unique in the table.

weight.description: Its chance relative to the other entries: weight over the sum of all weights; 1 to 1000.

wet.description: When true, an exposed flame will not light in this weather.

Word.description: One spoken word: 1 to 32 ASCII letters, the riddle answer's bound. The rule case-folds it and compares it only with authored keywords; it never reaches narration.

WorldSettings.description: Settings for the whole world, each optional with a default: what a move costs (movement.cost, by default 1 mv), how room tags change that cost (movement.terrain), and the condition words for any pool without its own (bands).

combat.description: How fights run: the player's own attack, time between rounds and the lines told.

construction.description: Building limits: max_total is the most structures that can stand in the world at once.

max_total.description: The most structures built in this world at once.

death.description: What happens when a player or NPC dies: corpses, how long they last and how the player comes back.

death_credit.description: NPCs whose death is credited to the player: killing one sets a true-or-false player fact.

derived.description: Opts into stats derived from the player's attributes. Each table's bonus is added to the authored number it modifies: hit_chance to the attack profile's chance (clamped 0..100), damage to both damage_min and damage_max (clamped at 0), carry_grams to carry.max_grams (clamped at 0), hp_max to the player body's hp maximum (clamped at the pool minimum). hit_chance and damage need world.combat; carry_grams needs world.carry. An NPC keeps its authored profile unless it declares attributes: then hit_chance and damage apply to its attack with its own values.

carry_grams.description: Bonus to how much the player can carry, in grams, by attribute value.

damage.description: Bonus to the player's damage, by attribute value.

hit_chance.description: Bonus to the player's chance to hit, by attribute value.

hp_max.description: Bonus to the player's maximum hit points, by attribute value.

gear_budget.description: For balancing only: how much bonus an item in each slot may carry at level 1 (per_slot), and how much each level above 1 adds (per_level). It does not change play; only the power report reads it.

per_level.description: What each level above 1 adds to the slot's budget. Read only by the power report.

per_slot.description: The gear budget for each equipment slot, such as head or hands; a slot not listed has no budget.

group.description: Groups of NPCs: member, stay and fight each name a true-or-false fact read at each NPC; wage pays every member amount of a resource every `every` clock units.

fight.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: the hireling order to fight.

member.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: this NPC is in the player's group.

stay.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: the hireling order to stay.

wage.description: Pays each group member from the player's purse on a schedule; a member who cannot be paid leaves the group.

amount.description: How much of the resource each member is paid.

resource.description: The conserved resource paid.

identity.description: The player's name as shown, with optional variants that change it while their condition holds.

name.description: Text key of the player's displayed name.

name_variants.description: Variants of the name; the first match wins, with the player's body as subject target.

levelling.description: Opts into experience and levelling. thresholds are the strictly increasing experience totals that reach levels 2, 3 and so on; points_per_level the attribute points each level grants; kills the experience a credited kill of each NPC definition grants; level_up the receipt line when a decision reaches a new level. Every number is the cartridge's.

gained.description: The line telling the experience a proposal added, binding amount.

kills.description: The experience a credited kill of each NPC definition grants.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

level_up.description: The receipt line when a decision reaches a new level.

thresholds.description: Strictly increasing experience totals that reach levels 2, 3 and so on.

mount.description: Riding names a bool pair fact, per subject and scoped to player, read at each NPC with a mount declaration; such an NPC carries its rider.

riding.description: A bool pair fact, per subject and scoped to player: the player rides this NPC.

movement.description: What a move costs the body, and how destination room tags scale it.

cost.description: What one move costs the body, such as 1 movement point.

terrain.description: Move cost by room tag, in percent of the usual: 100 leaves it unchanged, 50 halves it and 200 doubles moves into rooms with that tag.

theft.description: Take may lift an item a living NPC in the actor's room directly holds. The victim notices when the actor's level in skill is below the victim's value of attribute (absent: 0); every other living NPC there that is not blind and the actor's body is not concealed from also sees. Containment alone sets the per_subject instance bool fact stolen true on the item; a seen theft emits custom_event noticed (subject: the thief's body) and says narration.seen, an unseen one narration.unseen.

attribute.description: The victim's attribute compared with the actor's skill level. Absent: 0.

narration.description: Text keys told after a theft.

seen.description: Told when the theft is noticed.

unseen.description: Told when nobody notices the theft.

noticed.description: Key of the custom event emitted when a theft is seen.

skill.description: The victim notices when the actor's level in this skill is below the victim's attribute.

stolen.description: The per_subject instance bool fact set true on a stolen item.

trails.description: A trail is fresh while now minus its time is below fresh_for (logical seconds); a passed track check appends leads[<exit>], one per direction some room's exit uses.

fresh_for.description: A trail is fresh while now minus its time is below this, in logical seconds.

leads.description: What a passed track check appends, per direction some room's exit uses.

down.description: Appended when the trail leads down.

east.description: Appended when the trail leads east.

north.description: Appended when the trail leads north.

south.description: Appended when the trail leads south.

up.description: Appended when the trail leads up.

west.description: Appended when the trail leads west.

water.description: Deep water: who may dive, how long they can stay under before drowning and which rooms connect.

partial.ActionCraft.description: What a crafting action uses up and makes. consume: the items taken from the player's hands into a holder on every try; yield: an item moved from a holder to the player unless the action fails.

consume.description: What the actor gives up on every accepted perform, failure included.

items.description: The items that can be consumed.

quantity.description: How many of them are consumed.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the actor holds too few.

to.description: Where the consumed items go: the holder they are moved to.

yield.description: What the actor receives unless the outcome is failure.

from.description: The holder the yielded item is taken from.

items.description: The items that can be yielded; one of them, directly in the holder, moves to the actor's body.

partial.ActionNarration.description: A scripted action outcome's narration: the actor's line, the observers' line, and the entities the actor's line names, each resolved and pinned when the outcome commits.

actor.description: Text key of the actor's line.

observers.description: Text key of the observers' line.

participants.description: The entities the actor's line names.

partial.AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

attacks.description: Swings: how many swings one opportunity makes, each rolled on its own, their damage summed (1 to 10; default 1).

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

crit.description: A hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent of all attacks, sharing the accuracy draw: a hit whose draw is below this is critical, so a chance above the accuracy makes every hit critical.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

anyOf.description: A roll of chance: passes when a random number from 0 to 99 is below chance. Example: chance 50 passes half the time.

chance.description: Passes when a draw from 0 to 99 is below this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A fixed test: passes when the player's resource, such as stamina, is at least difficulty. No dice.

difficulty.description: Passes when the resource is at least this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

resource.description: The body's resource, read at admission before costs.

anyOf.description: Passes when the actor's value of the attribute is at least difficulty; draws no random number.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A test of the player's skill or attribute against a number (rating) or against an NPC's attribute. It never rolls dice: it passes when the player's value is at least the other.

attribute.description: The attribute compared; give this or skill, not both.

failure.description: The failure branch; a dialogue choice needs it, a scripted action refuses it.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

npc.description: With attribute, compares against this NPC's value of the attribute instead of a rating.

rating.description: The target detail's rating; a scripted action refuses it.

skill.description: The skill whose level is compared; give this or attribute, not both.

anyOf.description: Passes while the named population has left a fresh trail in the player's room. It never rolls dice. On success, the outcome's lines are followed by a line pointing the way the trail leads.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

plan.description: Key of the population plan whose trail is looked for; passes when that trail is fresh in the actor's room.

partial.Check.description: A test the action makes before it succeeds; kind says which sort of test.

partial.Connection.description: An exit to another room of this game. Add a door with barrier; the room on the other side needs the matching exit back with the same door.

barrier.description: The barrier the exit passes through.

climb.description: This exit is a climb: a player holding the named item climbs safely; without it they fall, still arrive, and lose some health (never below 1).

damage.description: HP a fall costs; a fall never takes HP below 1.

item.description: The item a mover must hold to climb rather than fall.

corpse_ingress.description: Close this directed exit while the named global fact has the specified value, except for the living owner of a nonempty player corpse in its destination. The exception is rechecked at movement admission.

equals.description: The value at which the exit is closed.

fact.description: The global fact that closes the exit.

hidden_until.description: This exit is hidden from the player until the named fact has the given value.

equals.description: The value that reveals the exit; of the fact's type.

fact.description: A fact of this cartridge, normally a player bool; the exit stays hidden until it has the value.

knock.description: The face's answer to a knock.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to go through this exit; otherwise the move is refused.

traverse.description: A condition the player must meet to go through this exit.

to.description: The room this exit leads to.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

partial.DialogueChoice.description: One option the player can pick in a conversation: its button text, the line it tells, and what it does (steps, a quest to accept, an item to hand over). It can also have a condition that hides it, a check with what opens next on success (then) or failure (then_failed), or then: end to close the conversation.

accept.description: A quest of this cartridge the choice activates.

asked.description: The Book dims this choice once taken; it stays usable. Lowered to the fact <dialogue>_<choice>_asked, a step that sets it and asked_when.

availability.description: Time limits on offering the choice.

from.description: First logical time the choice is offered.

through.description: Last logical time the choice is offered, inclusive.

check.description: An opposed check made when chosen.

escort.description: Starts, rejoins or completes an escort: npc names the NPC who follows the player. start and rejoin keep the conversation going; complete finishes the dialogue's quest.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

hand_over.description: The item role the actor gives to an npc role.

lesson_payment.description: An amount of a resource the actor pays for a lesson.

amount.description: How much.

resource.description: The resource paid.

narration.description: Text key of what the actor reads on choosing.

narration_variants.description: Other lines read on choosing, each used while its condition holds.

once.description: This choice goes away once taken: lowered to the fact <dialogue>_<choice>_done, a step that sets it and a policy that needs it unset.

order.description: Where this choice is listed, lowest first; choices without one come after, and ties are sorted by key.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

payment.description: An amount of a resource paid to the actor by an NPC role.

amount.description: How much.

resource.description: The resource paid.

policy.description: When this option is shown: a condition the player must meet, checked with the speaker.

receive.description: The bound NPC-held item transferred to the actor.

sitting.description: Once taken, this choice is hidden until the conversation is next opened. Only on a plain answer in a dialogue that reopens.

steps.description: What happens when the player picks this option, in order.

story_point.description: <story point>/<outcome>: the outcome this choice reaches; one per outcome.

then.description: The conversation to go to next, or end to finish talking.

then_failed.description: The conversation to go to next when this option's check fails.

anyOf.description: An NPC of this cartridge takes this role.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

anyOf.description: An item of this cartridge takes this role.

partial.DialogueRole.description: Who plays this role in the conversation: an NPC or item of this game.

anyOf.description: A lightable item that burns fuel while lit, and is refilled from a supply item.

capacity.description: The most fuel the source holds, in its unit.

cues.description: Cues active only while this source is lit.

doused.description: Text key of the line told when it is put out.

ignited.description: Text key of the line told when it is lit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

rate.description: Fuel burned per logical time unit while lit; at least 1. It goes out when the fuel runs out.

refueled.description: Text key of the line told when it is refilled.

supply.description: The supply item that refuels it; the supply's unit must match.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; the supply must use the same one.

anyOf.description: An item that holds fuel for refilling sources; it is emptied by what it gives.

capacity.description: The most fuel the supply holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; a source takes only a supply with the same one.

partial.FuelSpec.description: Immutable authored source or supply metadata; sources bind one compatible supply and their narration keys.

partial.InspectableDetail.description: Something in a room the player can look at, such as a well or a painting: the words that name it (the first is its own name and must not start with a, an, the or at), its description, and other descriptions picked by condition.

aliases.description: The words a player names it by; the first also names an ambiguous lookup.

bed.description: Makes the detail a bed: resting here is offered when the entitlement fact reads true.

entitlement.description: The fact that must read true for the actor before resting here is offered.

title.description: Text key of the title of the bed's page.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this detail: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

harvest.description: Makes the detail a place to gather items from.

careful.description: A slower way to gather: several items at once, for a skilled actor.

action.description: The harvest action offered for it; must be a harvest action that takes a method.

count.description: Items gathered at once; 2 to 64, and at most the distinct items listed.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after a careful harvest.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable for the careful way.

items.description: The item definitions that can be gathered; each harvest takes the ones lying in the room.

label.description: Text key of the harvest action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after an ordinary harvest (one item).

title.description: Text key of the title of the harvest page.

tool.description: Harvest needs a held item whose definition declares tag.

tag.description: The tag a held item must carry for the harvest to be allowed.

liquid_source.description: The liquid a held vessel can be filled with at this detail.

notice_board.description: Makes the detail a board that lists other readable details of the room.

notices.description: The notices on the board, in order: 1 to 64, all different.

detail.description: A readable detail in the same room.

title.description: The notice's title on the board.

self_luminous.description: Must be true: the detail gives light, so it is seen in a dark room.

title.description: Text key of the title of the detail's page.

rating.description: The value an opposed scripted action check against this detail must reach.

readable.description: Text the player can read here, and the label of the read action; both are text keys.

title.description: Text key of the title of the readable's page; without it the label is shown.
The title shown on this detail's page in the Book (a text key). Without it the page uses a general title.

transport.description: Makes the detail a stop on a transport route.

route.description: The transport route this stop belongs to.

title.description: Text key of the title of the stop's page.

partial.ItemBandage.description: A directly held item opted into exact bleed treatment.

action.description: Must be bandage: the key of the action that applies it.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when the bandage is applied.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable to bandage.

partial.ItemEdible.description: Held-food metadata; a complete original item grants its effect (capped recovery, cures, applies) when Consume commits.

amount.description: Positive integer; the canonical numeric profile supplies the safe-integer upper limit.

applies.description: Statuses Consume applies to the eater's body after the recovery and any cures, through the shared status apply (status_applied on a first application, immune holds, a refresh is silent); none may modify an hp-maximum attribute.

cures.description: Statuses this food ends when eaten; the player may eat it while one is active even when full.

label.description: Text key of the eat action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told when it is eaten.

resource.description: The pool eating restores (for example mv); with amount, or neither.

anyOf.description: Starts lying in a room.
Starts carried by an NPC.

npc.description: The NPC carrying it.

anyOf.description: Starts inside another item of this cartridge.
Starts nowhere: it is a copy source only, and exists in play only once another rule makes a copy.

partial.ItemLocation.description: Where the item is when the game starts: in a room, held by an NPC, or inside another item.

partial.ItemReadable.description: One explicit held-item Read, with optional declared Boolean topic grant.

label.description: Text key of the read action's button.

text.description: Text key of what the player reads.

topic.description: A topic the reader learns on reading.

partial.KnockResponse.description: A local barrier face’s authored answer when the named NPC is in the destination room, and its no-answer text.

npc.description: The NPC listened for.

room.description: The room it must be in.

unanswered.description: Text key of the no-answer line.

partial.LiquidRow.description: Exact vessel contents: null iff zero, positive declared kind bounded by immutable capacity.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

kind.description: The declared liquid; null iff quantity is zero.

partial.NameWords.description: Name words: bare, the text key of the name with no article ("lantern"); optionally article, the article a presenter puts before bare (a, an or the); optionally plural, the text key of the plural ("lanterns"). short stays the phrase narration binds; words exist for presenters that compose a sentence from several names. Each key is in the text catalog.

article.description: The article a presenter puts before bare.

bare.description: Text key of the name with no article.

anyOf.description: An NPC of this cartridge.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

anyOf.description: An item of this cartridge.
The player's own body.

partial.NarrationParticipant.description: Someone or something the narration names: an NPC or item of this game, or the player.

partial.NpcHp.description: This NPC's health: its lowest, highest and starting value and how much it regains. Lowest is at most starting, which is at most highest, and none is below 0.

gain.description: HP added each hour (3600 seconds), up to maximum.

anyOf.description: Every item holds; an empty list is the policy with no condition.

items.description: The policies that must all hold.

anyOf.description: At least one item holds.

items.description: The policies of which one must hold.

anyOf.description: The item does not hold.

item.description: The policy that must not hold.

npc.description: Reads this NPC's authored instance.

with.description: An npc_pair fact's second NPC, read at the pair (subject toward with).

anyOf.description: Holds during a range of hours of the day: from (included) up to to (not included), wrapping past midnight. Example: from 20 to 6 is night. From and to must differ.

to.description: End hour, exclusive; the window wraps at day end.

anyOf.description: True while the door is in this state: open, closed or locked.
True while the player's attribute is at least this value.

at_least_percent.description: The least percent of the pool's maximum that holds.

resource.description: The pool.

subject.description: `subject` reads the pool on a reaction's event subject.

anyOf.description: True while the player's escort for the named quest has this status.
Holds while the player's room is dark.

tag.description: The tag a worn item declares.

anyOf.description: True once the player has entered the room at least this many times. The starting room counts as entered once.

at_least.description: The least entry count that holds.

anyOf.description: True while the player's level in the named skill is at least at_least: 1 when learned, plus one for each growth step reached through use; 0 if not learned.

skill.description: The skill.

anyOf.description: True while the named population has at least at_least living members.

at_least.description: The least living count that holds.

True while an item with this tag lies on the floor of the player's room, not carried and not in a container. In a reaction, the room is the acting character's.

tag.description: The tag of an item on the floor.

npc.description: The NPC.

item.description: Read the fact on this item.

subject.description: Set to target to read the fact on the action's target.

with.description: For a fact held between two NPCs: the other NPC.

anyOf.description: True once at least at_least time has passed since the time stored in a number fact, read at its named NPC or item. A fact never set holds its default.

at_least.description: The least elapsed time that holds.

fact.description: The int fact holding a stamp.

npc.description: Reads this NPC's authored instance.

partial.Policy.description: A condition: a test on the world, such as a fact's value or where the player is. Combine tests with all, any and not.

partial.QuestJournal.description: The journal text for each stage of the quest; all five stages are required. outcomes can replace the ending text per outcome, active_variants can replace the active text while a condition holds (the first that holds wins), and hints add text after a number of real minutes in a stage.

active_variants.description: Checked in order for active quests.

text.description: Text key shown while this variant's condition holds.

when.description: This journal text is used only while this condition holds.

hints.description: Timed nudges the Journal shows as real time passes in a stage.

active.description: Hints for the active stage, earliest first.

objectives_met.description: Hints for the objectives-met stage, earliest first.

after.description: Real minutes since the stage began, scaled by time_policy.rate (no hint shows without one); 1 to 1440, strictly ascending.

objectives_met.description: Text key once objectives are met.

Met when the quest's expedition succeeds.

partial.RestBinding.description: One exact paid Rest binding: authored bed, first-credit fact and sole quest.

credit.description: The true-or-false fact that records the first rest.

detail.description: The bed: a detail of that room.

entitlement.description: The true-or-false fact that paying for the bed sets.

room.description: The inn room with the bed.

partial.ScriptedTarget.description: What the action works on: a detail in a room (offered while the player is there), a tool used on another item, or a spell's word.

Starts a status, or refreshes it if already active. In a reaction it lands on the event's subject, the named item or NPC, or every living NPC in the room; in a spell, on the named NPC, the aimed target or the caster. Anything immune to the status is skipped.

co_present.description: Put the status on every living NPC in the room (not the player) instead of one target.

item.description: Lands on this item's authored instance.

npc.description: Lands on this NPC's authored instance; never with item.

room.description: Put the status on this room instead of a person or item.

tag.description: With co_present only: put the status on every item lying in the room with this tag instead.

anyOf.description: Force a door, or every door here with this tag, into a state with no key or check, such as a door burnt open. Locking needs the door's key to exist.

tag.description: Moves every barrier on an exit of the event's room carrying this tag.

anyOf.description: Ends this status where it is active: on the event's subject in a reaction, or on the scripted action's target. No line is shown.
Give the player this much experience; needs levelling in the world settings.

amount.description: Experience to add.

anyOf.description: End the acting character's open conversation as Leave would (one choice.close, no event, no line); with none open, nothing.
For decay rules: moves the event's item into room, unless it is already there or used up. Nothing is checked and nothing is told; any other subject is left alone.

room.description: The room the item moves to.

anyOf.description: Moves the named NPC (or the event's subject when it is an NPC) straight to room, or to the event's room, without using exits. With plan instead of npc, moves every living NPC of that population plan. Nothing happens if the NPC is dead, fighting, escorting or already there.

npc.description: The NPC to move; else the event's subject when it is an NPC.

plan.description: Moves every living member of this population plan instead; never with npc, room required.

room.description: The destination; else the event's room.

anyOf.description: For timed world events: adds one group of the population to its home, in a free slot, as the population's own births do. With no free slot nothing is born. No dice are rolled.

plan.description: The population plan to birth a bundle of.

anyOf.description: Run one restock at once: move items as the named replenish rule would, without waiting.

replenish.description: The replenish entry to run once.

anyOf.description: Adds the line text to what the player reads, after the lines of earlier steps. Changes nothing in the world.

NPC emotes: an NPC performs an emote of the cartridge's table. The emoter is npc (an authored instance alive in the delivery's room), else the delivery's subject; to subject names the subject as the target and needs the emote's to forms. Appends one emote.performed line, told only to a reader who sees the emoter; writes nothing, emits no event.

emote.description: The emote of the cartridge table to perform.

npc.description: The emoter, alive in the room; else the subject.

anyOf.description: Writes the delivery's logical time into an int fact (no maximum, minimum absent or at most 0) at the subject a fact.assign step writes at, as a fact.assign.

fact.description: The int fact that receives the delivery's logical time.

npc.description: As fact.assign npc.

anyOf.description: Emit a custom event.
Spells only: the named NPC (or the spell's target) takes this much damage of this kind, after its resistances; at 0 it dies, killed by the caster.

amount.description: HP lost before resistances.

kind.description: The damage kind, read against resistances.

npc.description: The NPC hit; else an aimed spell's target.

anyOf.description: Spells only: light the named fuel source (or the spell's target), as the ignite verb would.

item.description: The fuel source to ignite; else an aimed spell's target.

anyOf.description: Adjust a resource of the actor's body by `by`, stopping at its bounds.

resource.description: The pool on the actor's body.

anyOf.description: Builds structure in direction from the site room, for the actor. In a scripted action it works only on a success outcome; in a service it is a benefit. Refused when that spot is built already or the world's building limit is reached. With fact and escrow it becomes an order: the items are held and the room is built ready_after seconds later; a cancel returns the items but not the fee.

direction.description: The direction from the site the room is raised toward.

escrow.description: The items the player hands over with the order; ready_after seconds later the room is built.

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

ready_after.description: Seconds until the order job raises the room.

fact.description: With escrow, makes a commission: true from the order until the job raises the room.

anyOf.description: The player learns a skill.

skill.description: The skill the actor acquires.

anyOf.description: The player learns a topic they can ask about.

topic.description: The topic the actor comes to know.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: the player is now owed something, such as a paid room, recorded in a fact.

escrow.description: Items the player hands over with the order; they wait in the custody room. With ready_after and output, the order takes time and is claimed later, and cancelling returns the items but not the fee. With output and no ready_after it is an immediate trade.

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

output.description: The item lying in custody the order hands over.

ready_after.description: Seconds of work a claim waits for; needs output.

fact.description: The fact recording the entitlement.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: a meal that draws on the provider's stock and restores the body.

amount.description: How much is restored, up to its maximum.

debit.description: How much leaves stock per meal.

stock.description: The provider's resource the meal draws on.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: a drink served from a vessel that restores the body.

amount.description: How much is restored, up to its maximum.

vessel.description: The authored vessel the serving comes from.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: repairs the player's wielded weapon.

amount.description: Durability restored, up to its maximum.

fact.description: The durability fact of the wielded weapon (weapon.durability.fact).

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: collects the player's ready order.

service.description: The service whose order is claimed.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: cancels the player's order.

service.description: The service whose order is cancelled.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: puts the player's money into a shared vault; a fact shows their balance.

account.description: The bounded int player fact mirroring the balance.

amount.description: Currency moved, separate from the service's price.

vault.description: The NPC holding the shared pool.

anyOf.description: A service's benefit: takes the player's money out of a shared vault.

account.description: The bounded int player fact mirroring the balance.

amount.description: Currency moved, separate from the service's price.

vault.description: The NPC holding the shared pool.

anyOf.description: Repairs the built room in direction from the site once it has fallen into ruin. Refused when there is nothing to mend.

escrow.description: Items the player hands over with the order; they wait in the custody room. With ready_after and output, the order takes time and is claimed later, and cancelling returns the items but not the fee. With output and no ready_after it is an immediate trade.

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

anyOf.description: Tears down the built room in direction from the site. Only the player who built it can, and not while a corpse lies in it; everything on its floor moves to the site room.

partial.Step.description: One thing an action, reaction or choice does, named by op: set a fact, send a custom event, change a pool, and so on.

anyOf.description: The action takes no target.
One entity from the listed scopes.

scopes.description: Where the target is looked for: self, inventory, room_contents, room_occupants or inspectable_details.

partial.TargetSpec.description: The candidate scopes an action's target is resolved from (21 §7): the scopes the R6P proof resolves to an EntityId. Inspectable details use target-only EntityIds and the inspectable_details scope. equipped, connections, party and privileged global scope are added with their first use, with a target identity for non-entity targets (21 §6). Accepted kinds and capabilities are added with the capability registry.

partial.TextKey.description: Words shown to the player: write them inline as {"prose": "..."}, or give the key of a text in the text catalog, such as room.well.name (lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores).

partial.UseTool.description: What a use scripted action's tool must be, at least one property: an item whose definition declares tag, and a vessel holding some of liquid (quantity above 0).

liquid.description: A liquid the tool vessel holds some of.

tag.description: A tag the tool item definition declares.

partial.VesselSpec.description: Opted finite vessel shell with authored positive capacity and initial contents.

partial.WeaponProfile.description: An equipped weapon's required skill and authored attack profile.

durability.description: The bounded int entity fact holding this weapon's durability (its default is a new weapon's) and the amount each hit of its own attack takes off; at the fact's minimum it is broken and strikes unarmed.

fact.description: The bounded int fact that holds the weapon's durability.

wear.description: Durability each of the weapon's hits takes off.

ranged.description: The weapon shoots in an encounter's round 1, spending one of the body's ammo resource pool; it never strikes in melee.

ammo.description: The resource pool one unit of which each shot spends.

skill.description: The required skill.

partial.source.ActionDefinition.description: An advertised affordance (04 §19; 06 §20; 21 §7): stable key, name (its localization key), target spec, the portable Command type it resolves to (checked against the command registry when content compiles), presentation priority, required input parameters, policy and accessibility description. Aliases, costs and cooldown hints arrive with the text parser and cost capabilities.

command.description: The portable Command type it resolves to.

name.description: Text key of its name.

partial.source.BarrierDefinition.description: Shared mutable state for one logical door or gate (21 §5 Barrier), owned by barrier@1 (a cartridge with one requires it), keyed in CompiledCartridge.barriers by DefinitionRefString of kind barrier and named by the exits that pass through it (Connection.barrier): its key; keywords, the Alias words a player names it by after open, close, lock or unlock (the direction of its exit names it too); name, the text key of its short description ("the oak door"); initial, its state in a fresh world (BarrierState); and optionally key_item, the item whose holder may lock and unlock it (has_item: held directly or inside containers the holder holds). Without key_item no one can lock or unlock it. Damaged/repaired and blocked states join as optional fields. Optional tags are its property tags (entity.schema.json Tag, toolbox row G1).

initial.description: The barrier's state in a fresh world.

key_item.description: The item whose holder may lock and unlock this barrier.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of the barrier's short description.

opens_when.description: A condition its open command needs (toolbox row 10, barrier@1): while it fails, open is refused invalid_state; close, lock and unlock and an already open barrier are unaffected.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for.

partial.source.BleedDefinition.description: An authored body bleed duration, tick cadence and HP loss.

duration.description: How long it lasts, in seconds.

narration.description: Text told as the bleed starts, repeats, ticks and ends.

applied.description: Text told when the bleed first starts on a body.

expired.description: Text told when the bleed ends by running out.

refreshed.description: Text told when the bleed is applied again while already active.

tick.description: Text told on a tick that costs hit points.

partial.source.DialogueDefinition.description: A conversation with an NPC: who speaks (npc), when it is offered (policy), the question shown (prompt) and the choices the player can pick. Talking to an NPC opens its first dialogue, by key, whose condition holds. It can name a quest the choices resolve, and a riddle.

choices.description: The options the player can pick, each with a short id, a button label and what happens.

entry.description: Optional. true: talking to this speaker opens this dialogue instead of the one it would pick (at most one per speaker, not on a keyword dialogue). false: talking never opens it; only another dialogue's then does.

keyword.description: A word that, said or whispered to the speaker, opens this dialogue. Talking never opens it.

name.description: A distinct name (the Talk label) opts that authored control into exact dialogue selection; omission retains first-eligible Talk.

npc.description: The speaker, also an npc role.

policy.description: When this conversation is offered: a condition the player must meet.

prompt.description: Text key of the pending choice's prompt.
