quest.description: The quest a choice resolves, with the choice id as its outcome.

riddle.description: A riddle answered by a typed word.

answer.description: The answer that solves the riddle, compared lowercased.

bank.description: The letters an answer may use, each once per entry; an answer that does not fit is refused.

choice_id.description: The choice that takes a typed answer.

wrong.description: Line told after a wrong answer.

wrong_limit.description: Wrong answers allowed; the last one closes the choice for good. Leave out for unlimited tries. Needs the dialogue's quest.

roles.description: Participants bound when the talk opens.

partial.source.EmoteDefinition.description: NPC emotes (G9, emote@1; cartridge.md Emote declarations): one canned emote an NPC performs. Its key; others, the text key of the line every reader but the target reads ({actor}, the emoter); optional to, the forms with a target: to.others for the other readers ({actor}, {target}) and to.you for the target ({actor}). No label and no self form: only NPCs emote.

others.description: Text key of the line every reader but the target reads.
Text key for the other readers.

partial.source.ItemDefinition.description: An item: something the player can pick up, carry, wear or open. It has names and text, where it starts, and optional parts such as being a container, a worn slot, a lid or a weight.

affects.description: Attribute bonuses the item gives while worn, such as +1 strength.

ambient.description: Ambient lines told while the player is in this item's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines, every, chance?, when?}.

bandage.description: Makes the item a bandage that can treat bleeding.

barrier.description: The barrier on it, a container lid.

behaviours.description: Behaviours this entity takes on: each adds one copy of the behaviour's rules, with `{"param": "holder"}` replaced by this entity's key.

block_chance.description: Percent chance that this shield blocks while held.

capacity.description: Most items held directly; receptacles only.

container.description: Only explicitly authored receptacles hold items. Absence is false; capacity and barrier require this field.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this item: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

edible.description: Makes the item food: what eating it restores, cures or applies.

equip.description: Authored wear and remove words: the Wear and Remove labels and the worn and removed lines. Only with slot; each key is in the text catalog.

removed.description: The line told when the item is removed.

worn.description: The line told when the item is worn.

fuel.description: Makes the item a lightable fuel source that burns while lit, or a supply that refuels one.

give_allowed.description: False prevents ordinary Give of this item or any container holding it transitively; absence permits Give when contents allow it. Dialogue hand_over remains legal.

identified.description: A true-or-false fact: the item counts as identified, and its bonuses show, while the fact is true.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this item; each names a status of this game.

intended_level.description: For balancing only: the level this item is meant for, read by the power report (needs affects). It does not change play.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

location.description: Where a fresh world puts it.

locks.description: Conditions to take this item (get) or put things into it (put); a player who fails one is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take this item or anything inside it.

put.description: A condition the player must meet to put something into this container.

mass_grams.description: The item shell mass in grams, excluding its contents. Required on every item under world.carry; explicit zero is valid.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

readable.description: Lets the player read the item, and optionally learn a topic from it.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows while it lies there.

room_line_variants.description: Room line variants; first match wins.

slot.description: The slot it is worn in.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for.

vessel.description: Makes the item hold liquid: how much, and what is in it at the start.

weapon.description: Makes the item a weapon: the skill needed and its attack.

words.description: The item's name words, such as the bare name lantern, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

partial.source.LiquidDefinition.description: Cartridge-owned mass, integer serving and unit labels for a declared liquid.

amount.description: The capped restore of one Drink.

applies.description: loka-kgd.209: statuses a Drink of this liquid applies to the drinker's body, as an edible's applies; a service serving does not.

cures.description: Statuses (toolbox rows 1 and G13) a Drink of this liquid ends; a service serving does not.

name.description: Text key of its name.

resource.description: loka-kgd.209: the pool a Drink of this liquid restores, with amount; a service serving does not.

partial.source.NpcDefinition.description: A character other than the player: its key, words, name, room line and description as for an item, the room it starts in, and optionally how many items it carries, its daily schedule, its health, and names and descriptions that change with conditions.

ambient.description: Ambient lines or emotes told while the player is in this NPC's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines | emotes, every, chance?, when?}.

ask.description: What the NPC says when asked about a topic. The first answer whose topic matches and whose condition holds is told and teaches its grants topic; with none, the NPC does not know.

answers.description: What the NPC answers, topic by topic.

grants.description: Granted when this answer is given.

text.description: What the NPC says when asked about this topic.

topic.description: The topic this answer is for.

when.description: This answer is used only while this condition holds.

unknown.description: What the NPC says when no answer matches the topic.

attack.description: How the NPC fights: chance to hit and damage range.

attributes.description: This NPC's attribute values, used when a check is made against it and for its attack. An attribute left out has its starting value.

attribute.description: A cartridge attribute, read by opposed checks.

value.description: This NPC's value of the attribute.

behaviours.description: Behaviours this entity takes on: each adds one copy of the behaviour's rules, with `{"param": "holder"}` replaced by this entity's key.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this NPC: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

anyOf.description: One case of the hour: where the NPC goes, and optionally why and how.

goal.description: Text key told when the NPC leaves the player's room by this case; silent if the player does not see it go.

room.description: The room the NPC moves to when this case is chosen.

walks.description: The step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

anyOf.title: walk

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

anyOf.title: room ref

anyOf.description: One case of the hour: where the NPC goes, and optionally why and how.

goal.description: Text key told when the NPC leaves the player's room by this case; silent if the player does not see it go.

room.description: The room the NPC moves to when this case is chosen.

walks.description: The step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

when.description: This case is used only while this condition holds; leave it out to always match.

daily_schedule.description: Where the NPC goes during the day. Each key is an hour, such as 6 or 20; from that hour until the next listed one the NPC belongs in that room. The value is a room, or a list of cases tried in order. Example: {"6": "market", "20": "home"}.

disposition.description: How the NPC treats the player: hostile while hostile holds, else friendly while friendly holds, else wary. A hostile NPC refuses talk and trade and, with engage, attacks a player who walks in, or with arrest sends them to arrest.to; a friendly one gives its friendly discount.

arrest.description: Instead of engage: this hostile NPC stops a player who walks in, and no encounter opens.

narration.description: Said when the player is arrested.

to.description: The room the arrested body goes to.

engage.description: Said when this hostile NPC engages a player who walks in.

friendly.description: While this condition holds (and hostile does not), the NPC is friendly.

hostile.description: While this condition holds, the NPC is hostile: it will not talk or trade, and may attack.

refuse.description: The line shown on the NPC's page while it is hostile; it names the mood, not the reason.

drops.description: Loot table: in order, an item this NPC holds at genesis and its percent chance of passing to the corpse when combat kills the NPC; a failed item stays with the dead NPC.

chance.description: Percent chance, 1 to 100, that the item stays on the corpse; otherwise it is kept back.

item.description: An item of this cartridge held by this NPC.

hp.description: The NPC's hit points: minimum, maximum and starting value.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this NPC; each names a status of this game.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds; otherwise taking it is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds.

mount.description: This NPC can be ridden (needs mount in the world settings). While a character rides it, the character can only move into rooms with one of terrain, each move costs cost_percent of the usual (default 100), and the NPC moves along. Not on a spawn template.

cost_percent.description: Percent, 0 to 1000, applied last to the rider's move cost, rounded down. Absent: the cost is not scaled.

terrain.description: Room tags this mount carries a rider over; a move into a room with none of them is refused. 1 to 8 unique tags.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

perception.description: Hides the NPC until a fact is true.

discovered.description: A fact that must be true for this NPC to be visible.

resistances.description: How much less damage the NPC takes, in percent, from each kind of damage and from weapons of each material tag; negative means a weakness.

resource_starts.description: Starting value of each named resource.

room.description: The room a fresh world puts it in.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows.

shop.description: Makes the NPC a shopkeeper: the items offered, their prices and the lines told on buying and selling.

spawn_template.description: Not placed in a fresh world; used as a population template.

unattackable.description: This NPC can never be attacked and never starts a fight. An arrest still applies. If absent, it can be attacked when it has an attack profile.

words.description: The NPC's name words, such as the bare name guard, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

partial.source.PopulationPlan.description: One fixed-slot, two-room bounded population with an owned wander and replacement job.

area.description: The two rooms members wander between. They must be different rooms joined by exits in both directions, with no barrier on either exit.

birth_when.description: Toolbox row W12: while false at an occurrence, the plan births nothing above floor. Its tree may use only all, any, not, population_count, time_window, sky and barrier_state (SCHEMA_VIOLATION otherwise, from the compiler).

cap.description: Most members alive at once: the number of slots.

chance.description: Makes the plan an encounter plan (docs/system/mechanics.md Random encounters, toolbox row 9): each wander-boundary occurrence with an eligible slot draws one uniform(100) and a roll below chance births the first eligible slot. Absent: an RNG-free ecology plan.

corpse.description: Corpse template for members; overrides world.death.npc_corpse.

day_target.description: Members wanted by day. 0: only a population.spawn step fills the plan.

floor.description: Toolbox row W12: slots 1 to floor refill at the plan's next occurrence: a member dying there is due at its death time, not after replacement_delay, and they birth whatever birth_when says. At most day_target; refused with chance (SCHEMA_VIOLATION, from the compiler).

home.description: The room members are born in. It must be one of the two rooms in area, and the NPC template must sit in it.

hunts.description: Toolbox row W13: a member in a room holding a character's body holds; else each wander step takes the exit of the characters' fresh trail in the member's room when npcPassage admits it, else wanders as before; characters then leave trails (trail_exit, trail_at, instance scope); needs world.trails.

item.description: Item copied into each member's hands at birth. Needed unless the plan has a scavenge block, which then forbids it.

member_role.description: Origin role of each member; default hunter. Its directly held item has role loot.

night_end.description: Hour night ends: night is hour >= night_start or hour < night_end.

night_target.description: Members wanted by night. 0: only a population.spawn step fills the plan.

npc.description: The NPC each member is copied from.

pack.description: Makes the members of this plan fight the player as a pack, with helpers and flight.

flight_below_percent.description: A member flees when its hp is below this percent of its maximum (1 to 100). Frightened members flee too.

narration.description: Text keys told as the pack fights and flees.

enemy_fled.description: Text key per exit direction, told when a member flees through that exit. Every direction leading out of an area room needs one.

helper_joined.description: Told when another member joins a fight already under way.

pack_withdrew.description: Told when the fight ends with no pack member left in it.

primary_changed.description: Told when the member the player is fighting changes.

replacement_delay.description: Clock units after a member dies before its slot is refilled. At least wander_interval.

scavenge.description: Makes members carry loose items along a corridor to a nest. The plan must then have no item field.

corridor.description: Rooms a carrying member walks through, in order, ending at the nest room. It must include home, and each step needs an open exit both ways.

drop_rooms.description: Rooms where members pick up a listed item lying on the floor. Each must be on the corridor.

interval.description: Clock units between each step of a member's pickup or carry.

items.description: Items members will pick up: loose in a room, not containers, and allowed to be given away. At most 8.

narration.description: Text keys told at each stage of scavenging.

acquired.description: Told when a member picks the item up.

carrying.description: Shown on a member's entry while it is carrying an item to the nest.

delivered.description: Told when a member puts the item in the nest.

fallback.description: Told when a member cannot finish (the nest is full or the way is blocked) and drops the item where it stands.

shoo.description: Told when the player shoos a carrying member and it drops the item.

nest.description: Container item in the last corridor room where members leave what they carried. It must have room left.

sight.description: Makes prey members flee a player who stays in their room. Only for member_role prey.

delay.description: Clock units after the player and a member are in the same room before the member flees, if the player is still there.

narration.description: Text key per exit direction, told when the member flees that way. Every direction leading out of an area room needs one.

trail.description: Toolbox row W13 (mechanics.md Tracks and trails): a member's wander step and C4 flight write the room left's trail_<key>_exit and trail_<key>_at (engine facts, per room); needs world.trails.

walks.description: Toolbox row W26 (mechanics.md NPCs use doors): the wander step crosses its exit as a walking NPC does (npcPassage with walks): a closed door passes and stays closed, a locked one only for a member holding its key_item (unlocked, opened, closed and locked again); any traverse lock on the exit or enter lock on the room refuses it.

wander_when.description: Toolbox row W12: while false at a wander boundary, no member wanders. The same leaf limit as birth_when.

partial.source.QuestDefinition.description: A quest: its name, how the player takes it on (offer or a dialogue choice), its objective, and its journal text.

deadline.description: When the quest runs out: after a number of time units from when it starts, or at a fixed time. When time is up the quest fails.

after.description: Generic deadline: logical units from activation, at least 1. Exactly one of after or at.

at.description: The logical time the deadline falls due.

fact.description: Legacy deadline: the fact assigned at expiry.

outcome.description: The outcome the open instance fails with, carried by quest_failed.

trust_amount.description: Legacy deadline: how much trust_fact changes at expiry.

trust_fact.description: Legacy deadline: the fact adjusted at expiry.

exchange.description: Makes the quest a repeatable item-for-item swap with an NPC, run from a dialogue choice that has an exchange. Needs repeatable true, current_state evidence, and no deadline or offer.

contribution.description: Player int fact (starts at 0) that totals the faction gain this quest has given. Its maximum caps the total.

faction.description: Player int fact raised by increment on each exchange. Must differ from contribution.

incoming.description: Item definitions the NPC hands to the player, held by the NPC at the start. Same length as outgoing.

increment.description: Faction gain per exchange, cut short once contribution reaches its maximum. At most that maximum.

npc.description: The NPC swapped with. It must be present, hold the incoming items, and be the dialogue's own NPC.

outgoing.description: Item definitions the player hands to the NPC. Must be exactly the items list of a room detail's harvest. Same length as incoming.

quantity.description: How many items go each way in one exchange. At most the length of outgoing.

expedition.description: Makes the quest a guarded walk along a fixed route, with a shelter stop on the way. The objective evidence must be expedition and the quest takes no offer, repeatable, deadline, exchange or patrol.

actions.description: Keys of the scripted expedition actions that offer each stage.

restart.description: Action key that restarts after a failed attempt.

start.description: Action key that starts the attempt.

faction.description: Player int fact changed by faction_delta when the expedition completes.

faction_delta.description: Added to the faction fact on completion. Always negative, from -100 to -1.

footprint.description: Rooms the attempt may stay in. Entering any other room fails the attempt. At least 2, no repeats, and it includes start_room.

narration.description: Text keys told as the expedition goes.

completed.description: Told when the last step is walked.

failed.description: Told when the attempt fails, such as by entering a room outside footprint.

restart.description: Told when a failed attempt is restarted.

shelter.description: Told when the player takes shelter.

population.description: Population plan (with a pack) whose hunter member, if one is in the start room, opens a fight when an attempt starts or restarts.

route.description: Steps the player must walk in order, each from one room to the next by the named exit. At least 3; the first starts at start_room and each starts where the last ended.

direction.description: Exit taken from the room. It must lead to the step's to room and not be hidden.

shelter_detail.description: Key of the detail in shelter_room that offers shelter, once three route steps are walked.

shelter_room.description: Room where the player may take shelter. It must be route[2].to.

start_detail.description: Key of the detail in start_room that offers start and restart.

start_room.description: Room where the walk begins. Its start_detail starts and restarts the attempt, and it must be in footprint.

survived_fact.description: Player bool fact (default false) set true when the last step is walked.

name.description: Text key of its journal entry.

offer.description: The accept action offered while the actor has no instance.

policy.description: When the quest is offered: a condition the player must meet.

anyOf.description: The offer draws on a fixture in a room: the player must be in that room and see it.

detail.description: The detail's key in that room.

anyOf.description: The offer draws on an NPC: the player must be in its room with it alive and in view.

npc.description: The NPC the offer draws on.

target.description: The fixture or NPC the offer draws on. The offer is listed and admitted only while the target is in the actor's room, alive and seen.

patrol.description: Makes an NPC walk a looping route that the player follows from room to room. The quest is complete once required checkpoints are reached together.

checkpoints.description: Rooms where arriving together with the NPC counts once toward required.

initial_cursor.description: Index in route of the room the NPC starts in.

narration.description: Text key told when the patrol completes, naming the player and the NPC leader.

npc.description: The NPC who leads. It starts in route[initial_cursor], has no hp, attack or daily_schedule, and no other quest may patrol it.

required.description: How many different checkpoint rooms the player must reach with the NPC to complete the patrol.

route.description: Rooms the NPC visits in order, looping back to the first. Each step needs an exit to the next room that is not hidden or a climb.

trust_fact.description: Player bool fact (default false) set true when the patrol completes. No other patrol may share it.

repeatable.description: The quest may be taken again once resolved.

partial.source.ReactionRule.description: A rule that runs steps when something happens in the game: when names the event (such as a fact changing), any filters must match it, and the steps then change the world, such as setting a fact or starting a quest.

after.description: The steps run this many logical seconds after delivery, as a reaction job for the delivery's actor, when `when` holds at both times; due no earlier than 1 s after the proposal's clock.

anyOf.description: A fact's value changed.

fact.description: Only this fact.

anyOf.description: Someone entered a room.

npc.description: The entrant is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: Someone said a word an NPC heard; fires once for each NPC that heard it.

npc.description: The hearer is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: A character reached a level.

level.description: The event is for this level.

anyOf.description: The player asked an NPC about a topic.

answered.description: Only asks that were, or were not, answered.

npc.description: The asked NPC is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: A quest was completed with an outcome.
The player rested.
An item came into someone's hands: picked up, bought, given, harvested or stolen.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: An item was dropped.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A creature was shooed away from an item.
A quest started.
A choice was put in front of the player, in a conversation, a scene or speech.
The player picked an option in a choice.
A story point was reached.
A custom event sent by an event.emit step.
A scripted action finished.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A check passed.

check.description: Only the check with this key.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A check failed.

check.description: Only the check with this key.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A door or other barrier changed state, such as opened or locked.
A scene ended.
Someone died.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: An attack hit or missed.

attacker.description: The attacker is this NPC's authored instance; a player's blow never matches.

target.description: The target is this NPC itself; a blow on the player never matches.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A vessel was filled with a liquid.
A liquid was poured out.
Someone drank a liquid.
Fires at the start of every hour of the game day.
An active status took effect again, such as poison each tick.
A status was put on someone.
A status wore off.
A quest failed.

on.description: What sets this reaction off: one event, optionally narrowed to a room, item, NPC and so on. Example: {"event": "item_acquired", "item": "key"}.

silent.description: Says the rule changes things without telling the player, on purpose, so the checker does not warn. Used only while writing; the finished game drops it.

steps.description: The steps in order; a `wait` splits them in time.

anyOf.description: Run the steps after it this many logical seconds later, as a sibling delayed rule with the same `on` and `when`; `when` is read again when they run.

seconds.description: Logical seconds, added to the rule's `after` and the waits before it.

when.description: A condition that must also hold for the reaction to run.

zone.description: A zone name: the rule becomes one copy per room listing that zone, named <rule>_<room>. Leave on.room out.

partial.source.ReplenishPlan.description: One replenish entry (docs/system/cartridge.md Replenish declarations): each due job moves up to count of items, lowest EntityId first, from the holder from to the holder to until to holds cap of them, then schedules the next at its due time plus every. A move never exceeds to's declared capacity. The compiler (lib/loka/content/replenish.ex) refuses a template location, a holder with no placed entity (a spawn-template NPC or template item), an item holder that is not a container, an item to when any listed item is a container, from equal to to, duplicate items and an unresolved item or holder.

cap.description: Stop moving once the destination holds this many of the items.

count.description: The most items moved per run, lowest entity id first.

every.description: Seconds between runs, counted from the previous due time.

from.description: Where the items are taken from.

items.description: The items moved on each due run.

to.description: Where the items are put; filled until it holds cap of them.

partial.source.RoomDefinition.description: A place the player can be: its name, description, exits by direction (north, south, east, west, up, down), things to look at, other descriptions picked by condition, and tags.

actions.description: Actions the player can do in this room, such as pray at the altar.

ambient.description: Ambient lines told while the player is in this room: 1 to 4 of {lines, every, chance?, when?}.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

dark.description: The room is dark: a player without light, or blind, sees the line place.dark instead of the description and none of the room's contents. A dark_description replaces that line.

dark_description.description: Shown instead of the description while the room is dark; authoring it marks the room as having no light of its own.

details.description: Things in the room the player can look at, by short name, such as altar or window.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to enter this room; otherwise the move is refused.

enter.description: A condition the player must meet to come into this room.

name.description: Text key of its name.

sanctuary.description: Combat cannot be opened here and hostile NPCs do not engage on entry.

site.description: Where a structure can be built from this room: directions, the directions a built room may open on (none may be an existing exit), and structures, the kinds that may be built.

directions.description: Compass directions a built room may take from here.

structures.description: Structures that may be built from this room.

sound.description: Its sound bed tag, projected as place.sound: the host plays that tag's bed and exploration piece. The cartridge owns the names; a tag with no file plays the wild bed.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for, which also set the cost of moving in. Each tag once only, since a repeat would count its cost twice.

variants.description: Other descriptions of the room, each used while its condition holds, such as at night.

zones.description: The zones this room belongs to; a reaction with `zone` and no `on.room` gets one copy per member room.

anyOf.description: A scene that takes over the screen: some lines, a Continue button, then it ends.

on.description: What starts the scene: a story point reached, a quest outcome, a scripted action's success, or `start` (an opening scene, started at world creation, without outcome); an action start names the scripted action's room and detail.

action.description: Start when this scripted action succeeds; give its room and detail too.

detail.description: The detail of the action that starts the scene.

outcome.description: The outcome that starts the scene; success for an action.

quest.description: Start when this quest is completed with the outcome below.

room.description: The room of the action that starts the scene.

story_point.description: Start when this story point is reached.

on_end.description: What happens when the scene ends: facts are set, then a story point is reached.

fact.description: The fact to set.

outcome.description: The outcome the story point is reached with.

story_point.description: The story point reached when the scene ends.

steps.description: The scene's steps: one or more narrate steps, then await_ack, then end.

treatment.description: Presentation only: the Book treatment that draws this scene.

anyOf.description: A dream when the player rests in a paid bed: three lines, a choice of two, the chosen option's text, then Continue.

description.description: A short description of the scene.

name.description: The scene's name.

rest.description: Start when the player rests in this paid bed.

on_end.description: What happens when the dream ends: one fact is set and its quest is completed.

fact.description: The fact to set.

outcome.description: The outcome the quest is completed with.

quest.description: The quest to complete; the same quest as the bed's.

steps.description: Exactly these steps in order: narrate, narrate, narrate, choice, branch, await_ack, end.

partial.source.SceneDefinition.description: Modal narration or the consumed paid-Rest anchored, resumable presentation-only dream.

partial.source.ScriptedAction.description: An action the player can take, such as ring the bell: the words that start it, what it acts on, when it is offered, what it costs, an optional check, and what happens on success or failure.

aliases.description: Words a player types as its verb.

check.description: A check selecting success or failure.

cooldown.description: The action is refused until this much logical time has passed since the actor's last admitted attempt.

costs.description: What the action costs the player's body each time, such as 1 movement point; up to 8. If the player cannot pay, it is refused.

craft.description: Makes the action a crafting recipe: the items it uses up, the item it makes, or both.

duration.description: Logical time every accepted perform advances.

name.description: Text key of its name.

cues.description: Transient cues of this outcome, from the actor's room: perceived only by a cue_perceived condition of a reaction this outcome's check_passed, check_failed or action_completed causes; never stored or shown.

narration.description: The line the player reads on failure.

steps.description: What happens on failure, in order.

success.description: Runs when the check passes, or when the action has no check.

cues.description: Transient cues of this outcome, from the actor's room: perceived only by a cue_perceived condition of a reaction this outcome's check_passed, check_failed or action_completed causes; never stored or shown.

narration.description: The line the player reads on success.

steps.description: What happens on success, in order.

policy.description: A condition the player must meet; while it fails, the action is shown unavailable and refused.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the action's policy fails.

tip.description: A line the actor reads once, after the outcome's lines, on the first accepted perform.

partial.source.ServiceDefinition.description: Exact original-provider action and conserved quote with one typed immediate benefit.

benefit.description: Closed paid entitlement, finite meal recovery, provider-owned complete liquid serving (recovery is MV only) or, toolbox row 21, a repair adding up to amount to the wielded weapon's durability fact; or, toolbox row 20b, a claim or cancel of the named commission service's timed escrow order; or, toolbox row 25, a deposit or withdraw of amount between the player's pool and the vault NPC's, mirrored in the account fact, the price being the fee; or, Built rooms S2 to S5, a build, mend or raze of a site's room. One Step whose op is one of these 11 (C3 D5; the compiler refuses any other op, SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at benefit.op).

name.description: Text key of the service's name.

narration.description: Text told when the service is used.

price.description: Row kgd.70: 0 only on an entitlement with escrow, a barter.

partial.source.SkillDefinition.description: An acquired skill with authored display text and a policy for current qualification.

growth.description: Toolbox row 5 (docs/system/mechanics.md skill growth): strictly increasing use counts reaching levels 2, 3 and so on above the base; the count is the reserved player fact uses_<key>.

hidden.description: Homestead hs-14 (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill trees): the skill is left out of GameView skills, and of NPC lessons, while its prerequisite fails and it is not acquired. A dialogue choice that teaches it is not offered while it is so left out. A non-hidden skill whose prerequisite or qualification reads a hidden skill, a dialogue policy that reads one, and a dialogue label on a dialogue that teaches one are refused.

learned.description: Level-up rush (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill ranks): the authored line for acquiring this skill; GameView carries the key and the presenter tells it.

name.description: Text key of its display name.

prerequisite.description: Homestead hs-11 (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill trees): read for the acquiring actor with no target; skill.acquire is refused while it fails. A skill_compare naming this skill is refused.

profession.description: Homestead hs-14 (docs/system/book-ui.md Skill tree details): the profession heading this skill is listed under on the Character page.

ranks.description: Level-up rush (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill ranks): one entry per level, ranks[i] naming level i + 1. Needs growth and exactly growth.length + 1 entries; the compiler enforces both.

name.description: Text key of this rank's name.

reached.description: Text key of the line for reaching this rank.

partial.source.StatusDefinition.description: Toolbox row 1: one authored timed status on a body. Every tick_every seconds until duration ends, per_tick (signed) is added to resource, saturating at the pool bounds; a negative hp result at zero runs the death sequence. Applied by a reaction status.apply; ended by expiry, an edible that cures it, or death. A reapplication while active refreshes ends_at and keeps the pending tick. Optional modifies (row 2c) adds attribute modifiers, read at use while active; a status with modifies may omit per_tick, and then never ticks (its one job is the expiry).

allows.description: Status reader 4: the only Command types the holding body may issue while the status is active (a modal answer aside); named as blocks; may stand in for per_tick.

blocks.description: Status reader 4: Command types (CommandPayload type) the holding body may not issue while the status is active; each names a registered command other than run_job and elapsed (compiler UNKNOWN_COMMAND); may stand in for per_tick.

concealment.description: Status reader 8: while active on an NPC, the player does not see it; on the player's body, an NPC does not engage it on entry. invisible yields to a see_invisible perception; hidden to none, unless pierced_by. May stand in for per_tick.

cues.description: Cues active while this status is active on a holder, from the holder's room (toolbox row G6).

duration.description: Logical seconds, or permanent (toolbox row W8): no expiry and no job, kept by the same-body return, ended only by a cure; a permanent status that declares per_tick ticks until cured, with no ends_at (loka-rn3b).

fear.description: Toolbox row W21: while active on a pack member, its C4 flight is attempted on its every opponent turn, whatever its hp; may stand in for per_tick.

kind.description: Toolbox row loka-x6t.64: the status icon's polarity, shown as GameView ConditionView.kind; wins over the polarity derived from the effect fields.

modifies.description: Toolbox row 2c: while the status is active on a holder, each modifier is added to the holder's attribute as attribute@1 reads it.

movement.description: Status reader 7: the holding body's move cost and the terrain it may cross while the status is active; may stand in for per_tick.

cost_percent.description: Percent of each move's fare (world.movement.cost or 1 mv, after the flee multiplier) the holding body pays, rounded down; several statuses apply in turn in definition order.

passes.description: Terrain tags the holding body may enter: a move into a room tagged air, chasm or water is refused invalid_state unless the body's active statuses pass each such tag.

name.description: Text key of its name.

narration.description: Text told as the status is applied, ticks and ends.

applied.description: Text told when the status is applied.

expired.description: Told when a timed status ends; required unless duration is permanent (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION, loka-rn3b).

observed.description: Row G3 (loka-kgd.176): told when a first application lands on an NPC or item in the player's room that the player perceives, or on the room the player stands in (loka-x6t.37); with none, such a holder is silent.

skipped.description: Told, whole, when this status bars its holder's combat blow (loka-x6t.30); with none, the round tells the engine line combat.skipped, its bindings.status this status's name.

tick.description: Text told on each tick of the status.

per_tick.description: Signed; never 0, required unless modifies, fear, blocks, allows, resistances, perception, concealment or movement is present or duration is permanent (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION).

perception.description: Status reader 6: what the holding body perceives while the status is active. sight blind: every room is dark to it, a lit source or dark sight notwithstanding; dark_sight: sees in an unlit room as an ancestry's dark_sight does; see_invisible: sees a holder of an invisible status. hearing deaf: no sound cue reaches it. At least one field (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION); may stand in for per_tick.

hearing.description: deaf: no sound cue reaches the holder.

sight.description: Changes what the holder sees: blind (every room is dark), dark_sight (sees in an unlit room) or see_invisible (sees holders of an invisible status).

pierced_by.description: Toolbox row 16, only beside concealment: a seer whose attribute value (an NPC's declared value, a player's attribute@1 value) is greater than the holder's skill level sees through the concealment; a holder without a character is never pierced. No draw. While the holder is a player's body, an NPC that engages it on entry ends every active concealment status on it.

attribute.description: The attribute whose value the seer needs; it is compared with the holder's skill level.

skill.description: The skill whose level the seer's attribute value must beat to see through the concealment.

resistances.description: Status reader 5: while active on the struck body (the player's or an NPC's), each entry joins the G2 resistance sum of an attack on it, before the one -100..100 clamp; may stand in for per_tick.

resource.description: The pool per_tick changes; omitted only beside ticks (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION).

ticks.description: loka-kgd.209: several pools one tick changes, each by its signed per_tick (never 0), in place of resource and per_tick (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION beside either).

partial.source.StructureDefinition.description: Built rooms S1 (construction@1; cartridge.md Structure and site declarations): one structure a player may build at a room's site (RoomDefinition.site). Its key; name and description, the text keys of the room it becomes; optional variants (DescriptionVariant) and tags (Tag) as a room's; optional locks.enter, the policy the mover must hold to come into the built room, as a room's (toolbox row G7). Nothing builds in S1: the cartridge declares and both compilers check. Built rooms S3: optional max_per_owner, the most rooms of this structure one character may own at once; an order at the cap is refused service.construction_full. Built rooms S4: optional weathering, a status of this cartridge the room gets when it is raised (and again when mended); optional ruin, the status a mend cures (a reaction applies it, typically on weathering's status_expired), the mend benefit refuses service.nothing_to_mend unless ruin is active on the room.

description.description: Text key of the description of the room this structure becomes.

locks.description: Rules for the built room; enter is the policy a mover must meet to come in.

max_per_owner.description: The most rooms of this structure one character may own at once; an order past it is refused.

name.description: Text key of the name of the room this structure becomes.

ruin.description: The status a mend cures; mending is refused unless the room has it.

tags.description: Tags the built room carries, as on a room.

weathering.description: The status the room gets when it is raised and again when mended.

partial.source.TopicDefinition.description: A declared localized topic mapped to its player Boolean knowledge fact.

fact.description: The player Boolean knowledge fact it maps to.

name.description: Text key of its name.

partial.source.TransportDefinition.description: Paired original boarding detail, destination, conserved fare recipient and corpse recovery rooms.

action.description: Key of the scripted action that boards this transport. It must be a use_transport action on inspectable details taking route and quoted_fare.

name.description: Text key for the boarding action and its offer label.

narration.description: Text key told when the player makes the passage.

reverse.description: The paired return transport: boards at this one's destination, goes back to its room, with the same recipient and currency.

source.ActionDefinition.description: An advertised affordance (04 §19; 06 §20; 21 §7): stable key, name (its localization key), target spec, the portable Command type it resolves to (checked against the command registry when content compiles), presentation priority, required input parameters, policy and accessibility description. Aliases, costs and cooldown hints arrive with the text parser and cost capabilities.

command.description: The portable Command type it resolves to.

name.description: Text key of its name.

source.BarrierDefinition.description: Shared mutable state for one logical door or gate (21 §5 Barrier), owned by barrier@1 (a cartridge with one requires it), keyed in CompiledCartridge.barriers by DefinitionRefString of kind barrier and named by the exits that pass through it (Connection.barrier): its key; keywords, the Alias words a player names it by after open, close, lock or unlock (the direction of its exit names it too); name, the text key of its short description ("the oak door"); initial, its state in a fresh world (BarrierState); and optionally key_item, the item whose holder may lock and unlock it (has_item: held directly or inside containers the holder holds). Without key_item no one can lock or unlock it. Damaged/repaired and blocked states join as optional fields. Optional tags are its property tags (entity.schema.json Tag, toolbox row G1).

initial.description: The barrier's state in a fresh world.

key_item.description: The item whose holder may lock and unlock this barrier.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of the barrier's short description.

opens_when.description: A condition its open command needs (toolbox row 10, barrier@1): while it fails, open is refused invalid_state; close, lock and unlock and an already open barrier are unaffected.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for.

source.BleedDefinition.description: An authored body bleed duration, tick cadence and HP loss.

duration.description: How long it lasts, in seconds.

narration.description: Text told as the bleed starts, repeats, ticks and ends.

applied.description: Text told when the bleed first starts on a body.

expired.description: Text told when the bleed ends by running out.

refreshed.description: Text told when the bleed is applied again while already active.

tick.description: Text told on a tick that costs hit points.

source.DialogueDefinition.description: A conversation with an NPC: who speaks (npc), when it is offered (policy), the question shown (prompt) and the choices the player can pick. Talking to an NPC opens its first dialogue, by key, whose condition holds. It can name a quest the choices resolve, and a riddle.

choices.description: The options the player can pick, each with a short id, a button label and what happens.

entry.description: Optional. true: talking to this speaker opens this dialogue instead of the one it would pick (at most one per speaker, not on a keyword dialogue). false: talking never opens it; only another dialogue's then does.

keyword.description: A word that, said or whispered to the speaker, opens this dialogue. Talking never opens it.

name.description: A distinct name (the Talk label) opts that authored control into exact dialogue selection; omission retains first-eligible Talk.

npc.description: The speaker, also an npc role.

policy.description: When this conversation is offered: a condition the player must meet.

prompt.description: Text key of the pending choice's prompt.

quest.description: The quest a choice resolves, with the choice id as its outcome.

riddle.description: A riddle answered by a typed word.

answer.description: The answer that solves the riddle, compared lowercased.

bank.description: The letters an answer may use, each once per entry; an answer that does not fit is refused.

choice_id.description: The choice that takes a typed answer.

wrong.description: Line told after a wrong answer.

wrong_limit.description: Wrong answers allowed; the last one closes the choice for good. Leave out for unlimited tries. Needs the dialogue's quest.

roles.description: Participants bound when the talk opens.

source.EmoteDefinition.description: NPC emotes (G9, emote@1; cartridge.md Emote declarations): one canned emote an NPC performs. Its key; others, the text key of the line every reader but the target reads ({actor}, the emoter); optional to, the forms with a target: to.others for the other readers ({actor}, {target}) and to.you for the target ({actor}). No label and no self form: only NPCs emote.

others.description: Text key of the line every reader but the target reads.
Text key for the other readers.

source.ItemDefinition.description: An item: something the player can pick up, carry, wear or open. It has names and text, where it starts, and optional parts such as being a container, a worn slot, a lid or a weight.

affects.description: Attribute bonuses the item gives while worn, such as +1 strength.

ambient.description: Ambient lines told while the player is in this item's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines, every, chance?, when?}.

bandage.description: Makes the item a bandage that can treat bleeding.

barrier.description: The barrier on it, a container lid.

behaviours.description: Behaviours this entity takes on: each adds one copy of the behaviour's rules, with `{"param": "holder"}` replaced by this entity's key.

block_chance.description: Percent chance that this shield blocks while held.

capacity.description: Most items held directly; receptacles only.

container.description: Only explicitly authored receptacles hold items. Absence is false; capacity and barrier require this field.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this item: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

edible.description: Makes the item food: what eating it restores, cures or applies.

equip.description: Authored wear and remove words: the Wear and Remove labels and the worn and removed lines. Only with slot; each key is in the text catalog.

removed.description: The line told when the item is removed.

worn.description: The line told when the item is worn.

fuel.description: Makes the item a lightable fuel source that burns while lit, or a supply that refuels one.

give_allowed.description: False prevents ordinary Give of this item or any container holding it transitively; absence permits Give when contents allow it. Dialogue hand_over remains legal.

identified.description: A true-or-false fact: the item counts as identified, and its bonuses show, while the fact is true.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this item; each names a status of this game.

intended_level.description: For balancing only: the level this item is meant for, read by the power report (needs affects). It does not change play.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

location.description: Where a fresh world puts it.

locks.description: Conditions to take this item (get) or put things into it (put); a player who fails one is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take this item or anything inside it.

put.description: A condition the player must meet to put something into this container.

mass_grams.description: The item shell mass in grams, excluding its contents. Required on every item under world.carry; explicit zero is valid.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

readable.description: Lets the player read the item, and optionally learn a topic from it.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows while it lies there.

room_line_variants.description: Room line variants; first match wins.

slot.description: The slot it is worn in.

tags.description: Its tags: words a condition can check for.

vessel.description: Makes the item hold liquid: how much, and what is in it at the start.

weapon.description: Makes the item a weapon: the skill needed and its attack.

words.description: The item's name words, such as the bare name lantern, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

source.LiquidDefinition.description: Cartridge-owned mass, integer serving and unit labels for a declared liquid.

amount.description: The capped restore of one Drink.

applies.description: loka-kgd.209: statuses a Drink of this liquid applies to the drinker's body, as an edible's applies; a service serving does not.

cures.description: Statuses (toolbox rows 1 and G13) a Drink of this liquid ends; a service serving does not.

name.description: Text key of its name.

resource.description: loka-kgd.209: the pool a Drink of this liquid restores, with amount; a service serving does not.

source.NpcDefinition.description: A character other than the player: its key, words, name, room line and description as for an item, the room it starts in, and optionally how many items it carries, its daily schedule, its health, and names and descriptions that change with conditions.

ambient.description: Ambient lines or emotes told while the player is in this NPC's room and sees it: 1 to 4 of {lines | emotes, every, chance?, when?}.

ask.description: What the NPC says when asked about a topic. The first answer whose topic matches and whose condition holds is told and teaches its grants topic; with none, the NPC does not know.

answers.description: What the NPC answers, topic by topic.

grants.description: Granted when this answer is given.

text.description: What the NPC says when asked about this topic.

topic.description: The topic this answer is for.

when.description: This answer is used only while this condition holds.

unknown.description: What the NPC says when no answer matches the topic.

attack.description: How the NPC fights: chance to hit and damage range.

attributes.description: This NPC's attribute values, used when a check is made against it and for its attack. An attribute left out has its starting value.

attribute.description: A cartridge attribute, read by opposed checks.

value.description: This NPC's value of the attribute.

behaviours.description: Behaviours this entity takes on: each adds one copy of the behaviour's rules, with `{"param": "holder"}` replaced by this entity's key.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this NPC: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

anyOf.description: One case of the hour: where the NPC goes, and optionally why and how.

goal.description: Text key told when the NPC leaves the player's room by this case; silent if the player does not see it go.

room.description: The room the NPC moves to when this case is chosen.

walks.description: The step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

anyOf.title: walk

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition. cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

anyOf.title: room ref

anyOf.description: One case of the hour: where the NPC goes, and optionally why and how.

goal.description: Text key told when the NPC leaves the player's room by this case; silent if the player does not see it go.

room.description: The room the NPC moves to when this case is chosen.

walks.description: The step moves only when a path to room exists through exits a walking NPC may cross (breadth first, direction-key order, one query step per exit); the NPC moves in one step, each locked door on the path it holds the key of is unlocked, opened, closed and locked again; no path leaves it where it is.

when.description: This case is used only while this condition holds; leave it out to always match.

daily_schedule.description: Where the NPC goes during the day. Each key is an hour, such as 6 or 20; from that hour until the next listed one the NPC belongs in that room. The value is a room, or a list of cases tried in order. Example: {"6": "market", "20": "home"}.

disposition.description: How the NPC treats the player: hostile while hostile holds, else friendly while friendly holds, else wary. A hostile NPC refuses talk and trade and, with engage, attacks a player who walks in, or with arrest sends them to arrest.to; a friendly one gives its friendly discount.

arrest.description: Instead of engage: this hostile NPC stops a player who walks in, and no encounter opens.

narration.description: Said when the player is arrested.

to.description: The room the arrested body goes to.

engage.description: Said when this hostile NPC engages a player who walks in.

friendly.description: While this condition holds (and hostile does not), the NPC is friendly.

hostile.description: While this condition holds, the NPC is hostile: it will not talk or trade, and may attack.

refuse.description: The line shown on the NPC's page while it is hostile; it names the mood, not the reason.

drops.description: Loot table: in order, an item this NPC holds at genesis and its percent chance of passing to the corpse when combat kills the NPC; a failed item stays with the dead NPC.

chance.description: Percent chance, 1 to 100, that the item stays on the corpse; otherwise it is kept back.

item.description: An item of this cartridge held by this NPC.

hp.description: The NPC's hit points: minimum, maximum and starting value.

immune.description: Statuses that never take hold on this NPC; each names a status of this game.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds; otherwise taking it is refused.

get.description: A condition the player must meet to take an item this NPC holds.

mount.description: This NPC can be ridden (needs mount in the world settings). While a character rides it, the character can only move into rooms with one of terrain, each move costs cost_percent of the usual (default 100), and the NPC moves along. Not on a spawn template.

cost_percent.description: Percent, 0 to 1000, applied last to the rider's move cost, rounded down. Absent: the cost is not scaled.

terrain.description: Room tags this mount carries a rider over; a move into a room with none of them is refused. 1 to 8 unique tags.

name.description: Text key of its short description.

perception.description: Hides the NPC until a fact is true.

discovered.description: A fact that must be true for this NPC to be visible.

resistances.description: How much less damage the NPC takes, in percent, from each kind of damage and from weapons of each material tag; negative means a weakness.

resource_starts.description: Starting value of each named resource.

room.description: The room a fresh world puts it in.

room_line.description: Text key of the line a room shows.

shop.description: Makes the NPC a shopkeeper: the items offered, their prices and the lines told on buying and selling.

spawn_template.description: Not placed in a fresh world; used as a population template.

unattackable.description: This NPC can never be attacked and never starts a fight. An arrest still applies. If absent, it can be attacked when it has an attack profile.

words.description: The NPC's name words, such as the bare name guard, its article and plural, used to build sentences.

source.PopulationPlan.description: One fixed-slot, two-room bounded population with an owned wander and replacement job.

area.description: The two rooms members wander between. They must be different rooms joined by exits in both directions, with no barrier on either exit.

birth_when.description: Toolbox row W12: while false at an occurrence, the plan births nothing above floor. Its tree may use only all, any, not, population_count, time_window, sky and barrier_state (SCHEMA_VIOLATION otherwise, from the compiler).

cap.description: Most members alive at once: the number of slots.

chance.description: Makes the plan an encounter plan (docs/system/mechanics.md Random encounters, toolbox row 9): each wander-boundary occurrence with an eligible slot draws one uniform(100) and a roll below chance births the first eligible slot. Absent: an RNG-free ecology plan.

corpse.description: Corpse template for members; overrides world.death.npc_corpse.

day_target.description: Members wanted by day. 0: only a population.spawn step fills the plan.

floor.description: Toolbox row W12: slots 1 to floor refill at the plan's next occurrence: a member dying there is due at its death time, not after replacement_delay, and they birth whatever birth_when says. At most day_target; refused with chance (SCHEMA_VIOLATION, from the compiler).

home.description: The room members are born in. It must be one of the two rooms in area, and the NPC template must sit in it.

hunts.description: Toolbox row W13: a member in a room holding a character's body holds; else each wander step takes the exit of the characters' fresh trail in the member's room when npcPassage admits it, else wanders as before; characters then leave trails (trail_exit, trail_at, instance scope); needs world.trails.

item.description: Item copied into each member's hands at birth. Needed unless the plan has a scavenge block, which then forbids it.

member_role.description: Origin role of each member; default hunter. Its directly held item has role loot.

night_end.description: Hour night ends: night is hour >= night_start or hour < night_end.

night_target.description: Members wanted by night. 0: only a population.spawn step fills the plan.

npc.description: The NPC each member is copied from.

pack.description: Makes the members of this plan fight the player as a pack, with helpers and flight.

flight_below_percent.description: A member flees when its hp is below this percent of its maximum (1 to 100). Frightened members flee too.

narration.description: Text keys told as the pack fights and flees.

enemy_fled.description: Text key per exit direction, told when a member flees through that exit. Every direction leading out of an area room needs one.

helper_joined.description: Told when another member joins a fight already under way.

pack_withdrew.description: Told when the fight ends with no pack member left in it.

primary_changed.description: Told when the member the player is fighting changes.

replacement_delay.description: Clock units after a member dies before its slot is refilled. At least wander_interval.

scavenge.description: Makes members carry loose items along a corridor to a nest. The plan must then have no item field.

corridor.description: Rooms a carrying member walks through, in order, ending at the nest room. It must include home, and each step needs an open exit both ways.

drop_rooms.description: Rooms where members pick up a listed item lying on the floor. Each must be on the corridor.

interval.description: Clock units between each step of a member's pickup or carry.

items.description: Items members will pick up: loose in a room, not containers, and allowed to be given away. At most 8.

narration.description: Text keys told at each stage of scavenging.

acquired.description: Told when a member picks the item up.

carrying.description: Shown on a member's entry while it is carrying an item to the nest.

delivered.description: Told when a member puts the item in the nest.

fallback.description: Told when a member cannot finish (the nest is full or the way is blocked) and drops the item where it stands.

shoo.description: Told when the player shoos a carrying member and it drops the item.

nest.description: Container item in the last corridor room where members leave what they carried. It must have room left.

sight.description: Makes prey members flee a player who stays in their room. Only for member_role prey.

delay.description: Clock units after the player and a member are in the same room before the member flees, if the player is still there.

narration.description: Text key per exit direction, told when the member flees that way. Every direction leading out of an area room needs one.

trail.description: Toolbox row W13 (mechanics.md Tracks and trails): a member's wander step and C4 flight write the room left's trail_<key>_exit and trail_<key>_at (engine facts, per room); needs world.trails.

walks.description: Toolbox row W26 (mechanics.md NPCs use doors): the wander step crosses its exit as a walking NPC does (npcPassage with walks): a closed door passes and stays closed, a locked one only for a member holding its key_item (unlocked, opened, closed and locked again); any traverse lock on the exit or enter lock on the room refuses it.

wander_when.description: Toolbox row W12: while false at a wander boundary, no member wanders. The same leaf limit as birth_when.

source.QuestDefinition.description: A quest: its name, how the player takes it on (offer or a dialogue choice), its objective, and its journal text.

deadline.description: When the quest runs out: after a number of time units from when it starts, or at a fixed time. When time is up the quest fails.

after.description: Generic deadline: logical units from activation, at least 1. Exactly one of after or at.

at.description: The logical time the deadline falls due.

fact.description: Legacy deadline: the fact assigned at expiry.

outcome.description: The outcome the open instance fails with, carried by quest_failed.

trust_amount.description: Legacy deadline: how much trust_fact changes at expiry.

trust_fact.description: Legacy deadline: the fact adjusted at expiry.

exchange.description: Makes the quest a repeatable item-for-item swap with an NPC, run from a dialogue choice that has an exchange. Needs repeatable true, current_state evidence, and no deadline or offer.

contribution.description: Player int fact (starts at 0) that totals the faction gain this quest has given. Its maximum caps the total.

faction.description: Player int fact raised by increment on each exchange. Must differ from contribution.

incoming.description: Item definitions the NPC hands to the player, held by the NPC at the start. Same length as outgoing.

increment.description: Faction gain per exchange, cut short once contribution reaches its maximum. At most that maximum.

npc.description: The NPC swapped with. It must be present, hold the incoming items, and be the dialogue's own NPC.

outgoing.description: Item definitions the player hands to the NPC. Must be exactly the items list of a room detail's harvest. Same length as incoming.

quantity.description: How many items go each way in one exchange. At most the length of outgoing.

expedition.description: Makes the quest a guarded walk along a fixed route, with a shelter stop on the way. The objective evidence must be expedition and the quest takes no offer, repeatable, deadline, exchange or patrol.

actions.description: Keys of the scripted expedition actions that offer each stage.

restart.description: Action key that restarts after a failed attempt.

start.description: Action key that starts the attempt.

faction.description: Player int fact changed by faction_delta when the expedition completes.

faction_delta.description: Added to the faction fact on completion. Always negative, from -100 to -1.

footprint.description: Rooms the attempt may stay in. Entering any other room fails the attempt. At least 2, no repeats, and it includes start_room.

narration.description: Text keys told as the expedition goes.

completed.description: Told when the last step is walked.

failed.description: Told when the attempt fails, such as by entering a room outside footprint.

restart.description: Told when a failed attempt is restarted.

shelter.description: Told when the player takes shelter.

population.description: Population plan (with a pack) whose hunter member, if one is in the start room, opens a fight when an attempt starts or restarts.

route.description: Steps the player must walk in order, each from one room to the next by the named exit. At least 3; the first starts at start_room and each starts where the last ended.

direction.description: Exit taken from the room. It must lead to the step's to room and not be hidden.

shelter_detail.description: Key of the detail in shelter_room that offers shelter, once three route steps are walked.

shelter_room.description: Room where the player may take shelter. It must be route[2].to.

start_detail.description: Key of the detail in start_room that offers start and restart.

start_room.description: Room where the walk begins. Its start_detail starts and restarts the attempt, and it must be in footprint.

survived_fact.description: Player bool fact (default false) set true when the last step is walked.

name.description: Text key of its journal entry.

offer.description: The accept action offered while the actor has no instance.

policy.description: When the quest is offered: a condition the player must meet.

anyOf.description: The offer draws on a fixture in a room: the player must be in that room and see it.

detail.description: The detail's key in that room.

anyOf.description: The offer draws on an NPC: the player must be in its room with it alive and in view.

npc.description: The NPC the offer draws on.

target.description: The fixture or NPC the offer draws on. The offer is listed and admitted only while the target is in the actor's room, alive and seen.

patrol.description: Makes an NPC walk a looping route that the player follows from room to room. The quest is complete once required checkpoints are reached together.

checkpoints.description: Rooms where arriving together with the NPC counts once toward required.

initial_cursor.description: Index in route of the room the NPC starts in.

narration.description: Text key told when the patrol completes, naming the player and the NPC leader.

npc.description: The NPC who leads. It starts in route[initial_cursor], has no hp, attack or daily_schedule, and no other quest may patrol it.

required.description: How many different checkpoint rooms the player must reach with the NPC to complete the patrol.

route.description: Rooms the NPC visits in order, looping back to the first. Each step needs an exit to the next room that is not hidden or a climb.

trust_fact.description: Player bool fact (default false) set true when the patrol completes. No other patrol may share it.

repeatable.description: The quest may be taken again once resolved.

source.ReactionRule.description: A rule that runs steps when something happens in the game: when names the event (such as a fact changing), any filters must match it, and the steps then change the world, such as setting a fact or starting a quest.

after.description: The steps run this many logical seconds after delivery, as a reaction job for the delivery's actor, when `when` holds at both times; due no earlier than 1 s after the proposal's clock.

anyOf.description: A fact's value changed.

fact.description: Only this fact.

anyOf.description: Someone entered a room.

npc.description: The entrant is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: Someone said a word an NPC heard; fires once for each NPC that heard it.

npc.description: The hearer is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: A character reached a level.

level.description: The event is for this level.

anyOf.description: The player asked an NPC about a topic.

answered.description: Only asks that were, or were not, answered.

npc.description: The asked NPC is this NPC's authored instance.

anyOf.description: A quest was completed with an outcome.
The player rested.
An item came into someone's hands: picked up, bought, given, harvested or stolen.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: An item was dropped.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A creature was shooed away from an item.
A quest started.
A choice was put in front of the player, in a conversation, a scene or speech.
The player picked an option in a choice.
A story point was reached.
A custom event sent by an event.emit step.
A scripted action finished.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A check passed.

check.description: Only the check with this key.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A check failed.

check.description: Only the check with this key.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A door or other barrier changed state, such as opened or locked.
A scene ended.
Someone died.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: An attack hit or missed.

attacker.description: The attacker is this NPC's authored instance; a player's blow never matches.

target.description: The target is this NPC itself; a blow on the player never matches.

witness.description: This NPC's authored instance, alive in the event subject's room, sees the subject (not blind, the subject not concealed from it); an event's subject is never its own witness.

anyOf.description: A vessel was filled with a liquid.
A liquid was poured out.
Someone drank a liquid.
Fires at the start of every hour of the game day.
An active status took effect again, such as poison each tick.
A status was put on someone.
A status wore off.
A quest failed.

on.description: What sets this reaction off: one event, optionally narrowed to a room, item, NPC and so on. Example: {"event": "item_acquired", "item": "key"}.

silent.description: Says the rule changes things without telling the player, on purpose, so the checker does not warn. Used only while writing; the finished game drops it.

steps.description: The steps in order; a `wait` splits them in time.

anyOf.description: Run the steps after it this many logical seconds later, as a sibling delayed rule with the same `on` and `when`; `when` is read again when they run.

seconds.description: Logical seconds, added to the rule's `after` and the waits before it.

when.description: A condition that must also hold for the reaction to run.

zone.description: A zone name: the rule becomes one copy per room listing that zone, named <rule>_<room>. Leave on.room out.

source.ReplenishPlan.description: One replenish entry (docs/system/cartridge.md Replenish declarations): each due job moves up to count of items, lowest EntityId first, from the holder from to the holder to until to holds cap of them, then schedules the next at its due time plus every. A move never exceeds to's declared capacity. The compiler (lib/loka/content/replenish.ex) refuses a template location, a holder with no placed entity (a spawn-template NPC or template item), an item holder that is not a container, an item to when any listed item is a container, from equal to to, duplicate items and an unresolved item or holder.

cap.description: Stop moving once the destination holds this many of the items.

count.description: The most items moved per run, lowest entity id first.

every.description: Seconds between runs, counted from the previous due time.

from.description: Where the items are taken from.

items.description: The items moved on each due run.

to.description: Where the items are put; filled until it holds cap of them.

source.RoomDefinition.description: A place the player can be: its name, description, exits by direction (north, south, east, west, up, down), things to look at, other descriptions picked by condition, and tags.

actions.description: Actions the player can do in this room, such as pray at the altar.

ambient.description: Ambient lines told while the player is in this room: 1 to 4 of {lines, every, chance?, when?}.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

dark.description: The room is dark: a player without light, or blind, sees the line place.dark instead of the description and none of the room's contents. A dark_description replaces that line.

dark_description.description: Shown instead of the description while the room is dark; authoring it marks the room as having no light of its own.

details.description: Things in the room the player can look at, by short name, such as altar or window.

locks.description: A condition the player must meet to enter this room; otherwise the move is refused.

enter.description: A condition the player must meet to come into this room.

name.description: Text key of its name.

sanctuary.description: Combat cannot be opened here and hostile NPCs do not engage on entry.

site.description: Where a structure can be built from this room: directions, the directions a built room may open on (none may be an existing exit), and structures, the kinds that may be built.

directions.description: Compass directions a built room may take from here.

structures.description: Structures that may be built from this room.

sound.description: Its sound bed tag, projected as place.sound: the host plays that tag's bed and exploration piece. The cartridge owns the names; a tag with no file plays the wild bed.
